title: Revisiting structured-light propagation in screw-dislocation geometries: Landau dynamics and gradient-induced polarization textures
summary: We derive the propagation of finite electromagnetic beams in the effective metric of a continuous distribution of screw dislocations from gauge-invariant, minimally coupled Maxwell theory with $F=dA$. The Burgers flux fixes the metric profile through $σ(ρ)=f'(ρ)/(bρ)$, which separates true density gradients from coordinate factors. In geometric optics, both polarizations share one light cone, and a uniform density rotates the polarization uniformly relative to the geometry-adapted frame; laboratory polarimetry also requires matching at the interfaces. At leading paraxial order, the orbital motion is of Landau type, with a closed propagator for arbitrary inputs, and for a uniform density the polarization evolution factorizes exactly. For an arbitrary smooth axisymmetric density, the polarization texture initially grows in proportion to the standard deviation of the density weighted by the beam intensity; the local-phase coherence is the characteristic function of that distribution. For a coherent transverse Jones field, an exact relation links the linear-Stokes texture and the local circular polarization to spatial--polarization nonseparability. For linearly polarized, real axisymmetric input beams, diffraction produces local circular polarization at second order in the propagation distance, while the integrated circular Stokes component is conserved in the lossless leading-paraxial theory. Exact Maxwell eigenmodes, analytic results for a saturating profile, and numerical propagation test the approximation. We propose a full-Stokes measurement that compares uniform and graded samples with the same mean twist, with a closed-form criterion for the beam waist. These predictions apply to the ideal metric-Maxwell model or to a transformation-optics medium that realizes it, not to natural dislocated crystals without further constitutive modeling.

AI.tldr: 在连续螺旋位错的有效度规中，基于规范不变、最小耦合的麦克斯韦理论推导有限电磁束传播，给出几何光学与近轴偏振/轨道演化、精确关系及全斯托克斯测量方案，并限定于理想模型或变换光学介质。
AI.motivation: 摘要未显式交代研究背景；其目标是建立连续螺旋位错分布的有效度规中有限电磁束的传播理论，区分真实密度梯度与坐标因素，刻画偏振纹理和空间—偏振非可分性，并提出可比较均匀与梯度样品的全斯托克斯测量。
AI.method: 采用规范不变、最小耦合且 F=dA 的麦克斯韦理论；由 Burgers 通量通过 σ(ρ)=f'(ρ)/(bρ) 确定度规剖面。结合几何光学与领先近轴近似，构造 Landau 型轨道运动的闭式传播子；对均匀密度给出精确偏振因子化，对任意光滑轴对称密度用束强度加权的密度标准差描述偏振纹理，并以局域相位相干性的特征函数表述。还用精确麦克斯韦本征模、饱和剖面的解析结果和数值传播检验近似，并提出含束腰闭式判据的全斯托克斯测量。
AI.result: 两种偏振共享同一光锥；均匀密度使偏振相对几何适配框架均匀旋转，实验室偏振测量还需界面匹配。领先近轴阶轨道运动为 Landau 型，任意输入有闭式传播子，均匀密度下偏振演化精确因子化。任意光滑轴对称密度下，偏振纹理初始增长正比于以束强度加权的密度标准差，局域相位相干性为该分布的特征函数。对相干横向 Jones 场，线性斯托克斯纹理与局域圆偏振通过精确关系联系到空间—偏振非可分性。对线偏振、实轴对称输入束，衍射在传播距离二阶产生局域圆偏振，而无损领先近轴理论中积分圆斯托克斯分量守恒。精确本征模、饱和剖面解析结果和数值传播用于检验近似；所提全斯托克斯测量比较具有相同平均扭转的均匀与梯度样品，并给出束腰闭式判据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了有效度规中电磁束传播、偏振纹理和空间—偏振非可分性的解析与数值框架，并提出可检验的全斯托克斯测量判据；这些预测仅适用于理想度规—麦克斯韦模型或实现该度规的变换光学介质，不适用于未进一步本构建模的自然位错晶体。

title: Recovering hysteresis in reduced models of plasma turbulence: a Mori--Zwanzig-inspired closure
summary: Hysteretic transitions between turbulent and strongly zonal-flow-dominated states provide an important test for reduced models of plasma turbulence and a minimal setting for studying dynamics relevant to L-H transitions. The 12-mode truncation of the modified Hasegawa-Wakatani system developed by Guillon and Gürcan retains this transition but underestimates the hysteresis observed in direct numerical simulations (DNS). Guided by the Mori-Zwanzig framework, we construct a phenomenological closure for the influence of discarded modes. The discarded spectrum is coarse-grained into a reservoir, whose feedback on the retained modes is modeled together with a separate drift-wave damping term. Without increasing the number of retained modes, the closure recovers nearly all of the hysteresis width missing from the unclosed truncation and places both transition thresholds close to their DNS values. To test the model beyond hysteresis, we also examine particle flux. The closed model improves upon the unclosed truncation, agreeing more closely with DNS at low adiabaticity but underestimating transport at high adiabaticity. These results show that a low-dimensional representation of discarded-mode feedback can improve predictions of hysteretic turbulence-flow transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Guillon与Gürcan提出的12模态modified Hasegawa-Wakatani截断模型在湍流—强纬向流态滞回转变中低估滞回宽度的问题，基于Mori-Zwanzig框架构造丢弃模态影响的唯象闭合，并检验其对转变阈值和粒子通量的预测。
AI.motivation: 湍流与强纬向流主导态之间的滞回转变是检验等离子体湍流约化模型的重要测试，也是研究L-H转变相关动力学的简化场景；现有12模态截断虽保留该转变，但相比直接数值模拟（DNS）低估了滞回。
AI.method: 在Mori-Zwanzig框架指导下，将丢弃谱粗粒化为一个储层，对其反馈作用于保留模态的效应建模，并加入独立的漂移波阻尼项，形成唯象闭合；该方法不增加保留模态数，并进一步用粒子通量检验模型。
AI.result: 闭合模型恢复了未闭合截断所缺失的几乎全部滞回宽度，并使两个转变阈值接近DNS值；在粒子通量方面，闭合模型优于未闭合截断，在低绝热性下更接近DNS，但在高绝热性下低估输运。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，对丢弃模态反馈的低维表示能够改进对滞回性湍流—流转变的预测。

title: A widely-tunable printed-circuit-board-based resonant electro-optic modulator
summary: We present a simple, printed-circuit-board (PCB)-based resonant electro-optic modulator (EOM) featuring a wide operational frequency range. By utilizing a low-loss, high-frequency variable capacitor, the resonant frequency can be continuously tuned by typically 30% within a single band, e.g., from 161.0 MHz to 233.5 MHz. Furthermore, by swapping a radio-frequency transformer, the EOM's resonance is reconfigurable across the 17.7-489.7 MHz range, with quality factors ranging from 46 to 109. Using this design, we demonstrate the EOM's applicability by generating strong 228 MHz sidebands to verify its utility for ^6Li laser cooling and by locking a 780 nm laser to the Rb D2 transition using retroreflected modulation transfer spectroscopy at 20 MHz resonance. The device's reconfigurable wide frequency range and high quality factors make this EOM versatile for laser cooling of multiple atomic species, including ^6Li, ^39K, and ^41K, as well as for laser frequency locking. This design offers a flexible, robust, and practical solution for undergraduate teaching laboratories and quantum optics research groups.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于印刷电路板（PCB）的谐振型电光调制器（EOM），通过低损耗高频可变电容实现单频带内约30%的连续谐振频率调谐，并通过更换射频变压器实现17.7–489.7 MHz的宽范围可重构谐振，品质因数为46–109；作者用228 MHz强边带验证^6Li激光冷却适用性，并在20 MHz谐振下将780 nm激光锁定至Rb D2跃迁。
AI.motivation: 为满足多种原子（如^6Li、^39K、^41K）激光冷却及激光频率锁定对宽频率范围、可重构且高品质因数谐振EOM的需求，并提供适用于本科教学实验室和量子光学研究组的灵活、稳健、实用方案。
AI.method: 采用PCB构建谐振型EOM；利用低损耗、高频可变电容在单一频带内连续调谐谐振频率，典型调谐约30%（如161.0 MHz至233.5 MHz）；通过更换射频变压器使谐振在17.7–489.7 MHz范围内可重构，品质因数为46–109。
AI.result: 该EOM可产生228 MHz强边带，验证其用于^6Li激光冷却的可行性；并在20 MHz谐振下，利用回射式调制转移光谱将780 nm激光锁定至Rb D2跃迁。
AI.conclusion: 该器件具有可重构宽频率范围和高品质因数，适用于包括^6Li、^39K和^41K在内的多种原子激光冷却及激光频率锁定，为本科教学实验室和量子光学研究组提供灵活、稳健且实用的解决方案。

title: Burgers vectors from Voronoi topology
comment: 24 pages, 4 figures, plus 19 pages of Supplementary Information
summary: Automated dislocation analysis is standard in atomistic simulations, yet current tools are limited to a handful of crystal structures. We introduce an algorithm without adjustable parameters, based on Voronoi topology, that identifies dislocations in a broad class of crystals. Each face shared by two cells that match the ideal crystal is taken as a step in it, and summing these steps around closed circuits of such cells yields exact Burgers vectors, without geometric templates. Tested on dislocations inserted into all 9,610 Materials Project structures whose Voronoi cells are stable with a wide margin, the algorithm finds every dislocation with its correct Burgers vector. In raw molecular-dynamics snapshots, including eleven dislocation types in $θ$-Al$_2$Cu and bcc iron up to its melting point, every Burgers vector it returns is correct, although near melting the dislocations merge into one cluster. Voronoi topology thus provides a natural language in which a crystal, its defects, and their Burgers vectors are all described.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Voronoi拓扑、无可调参数的位错识别算法，可在多种晶体中直接给出精确Burgers矢量，并在大规模Materials Project结构测试和分子动力学快照中验证了准确性。
AI.motivation: 原子尺度模拟中的自动位错分析已成标准，但现有工具仅适用于少数晶体结构；作者希望发展一种无需几何模板、可推广到广泛晶体类型的位错分析方法。
AI.method: 构建基于Voronoi拓扑的算法：将两个与理想晶体匹配的Voronoi胞共享的每个面视为该理想晶体中的一步，沿这些胞的闭合回路累加各步，从而精确求得Burgers矢量；算法不使用可调参数或几何模板。
AI.result: 在9,610个Voronoi胞具有较大稳定裕度的Materials Project结构中插入位错进行测试，算法对每个位错均给出正确Burgers矢量。对原始分子动力学快照，包括θ-Al2Cu中的11种位错类型以及bcc铁至熔点附近的位错，返回的每个Burgers矢量均正确；但接近熔点时位错合并为一个团簇。
AI.conclusion: Voronoi拓扑为晶体、其缺陷及其Burgers矢量提供了统一的自然描述语言，表明该无参数拓扑方法可用于广泛晶体结构的自动位错分析。

title: Singular layer neural networks for the Navier-Stokes equations at small viscosity
summary: We develop neural network methods for the two-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations at a small viscosity $\varepsilon > 0$, whose accuracy is uniform in $\varepsilon$ and whose residual is evaluated on a grid that does not resolve the vorticity boundary layer. In the vorticity-stream function formulation with the slip boundary conditions, a vorticity layer of width $\sqrt{\varepsilon}$ forms along the walls. The trial function of the singular layer Physics-Informed Neural Network (sl-PINN) contains the corrector of the asymptotic analysis, together with the law that fixes its amplitude at the wall. The amplitude is tied to the wall trace of the network itself, so that the method requires no a priori knowledge of the limit solution. The sl-PINN keeps the error uniform in $\varepsilon$ over six decades, for the Stokes and the Navier-Stokes equations alike, although in the latter the wall trace travels with the flow and is not known in advance. An enrichment that uses the thin scale but leaves the profile and the amplitude of the layer free deteriorates as $\varepsilon\to0$. Since the corrector carries the layer analytically, the Laplacian in the residual can be discretized by a finite volume flux difference on a coarse grid. The resulting singular layer Finite Volume Neural Network (sl-FVNN) attains the same uniform accuracy as the sl-PINN, to within the scatter of the random seed, at about half the cost of a training step. The combination of the asymptotic corrector with the coarse-grid finite volume discretization is the main result of this article.

AI.tldr: 该文提出将奇异层渐近校正子嵌入神经网络，并结合粗网格有限体积残差离散，以求解小黏度二维不可压 Navier-Stokes 方程，使误差在黏度跨六个数量级时保持均匀，且无需预先知道极限解。
AI.motivation: 小黏度下壁面附近会形成宽度约为 sqrt(ε) 的涡量边界层；若残差网格不解析该层，常规神经网络难以保持对 ε 一致的精度。作者希望在不需要先验极限解、也不解析边界层的条件下，获得对 Stokes 与 Navier-Stokes 方程均一致的精度。
AI.method: 采用涡量-流函数形式与滑移边界条件。sl-PINN 的试探函数包含渐近分析中的校正子及其壁面振幅律，振幅由网络自身的壁面迹确定，因此无需预先知道极限解。由于校正子解析携带边界层，残差中的 Laplacian 可在粗网格上用有限体积通量差分离散，形成 sl-FVNN。
AI.result: sl-PINN 在 Stokes 和 Navier-Stokes 方程中均使误差在 ε 跨六个数量级时保持均匀；Navier-Stokes 情形中壁面迹随流动输运且事先未知。仅使用薄尺度但让层剖面和振幅自由的富集方法在 ε→0 时会退化。sl-FVNN 达到与 sl-PINN 相同的均匀精度，差异在随机种子波动范围内，且每个训练步成本约为后者的一半。
AI.conclusion: 将渐近校正子与粗网格有限体积离散结合是本文的主要结果；该方法避免解析涡量边界层并保持小黏度下的一致精度。摘要未给出具体误差数值、绝对计算成本及更高维或更一般边界的验证。

title: Optical rectification and Pockels effect in the organic nonlinear crystal MBI for quasi-discrete THz time-domain spectroscopy
summary: Organic nonlinear optical (NLO) crystals offer efficient nonlinear frequency conversion for broadband THz spectroscopy. Unfortunately, only a subset of NLO crystals is compatible with the telecom (~1.5 $μ$m) pump wavelength region, where convenient MHz-rate femtosecond fiber lasers are available. Here, we present ultra-broadband (1-30 THz) THz generation and detection using a benzoindolium iodide (MBI, C$_{24}$H$_{24}$NOI) crystal illuminated by a 1.5 $μ$m MHz-rate fiber laser. At 200 mW of average pump power, the crystal delivers ~1 $μ$W of THz radiation as quasi-discrete peaks covering the whole emission region with a prominent peak at 11.8 THz. High-dynamic range (>40 dB) time-domain spectroscopy is demonstrated within minutes of integration.

AI.tldr: 该文展示利用MBI晶体与1.5 μm、MHz重复率光纤激光实现1–30 THz超宽带太赫兹产生与探测；在200 mW平均泵浦功率下获得约1 μW太赫兹辐射，并可在数分钟内实现动态范围大于40 dB的时域光谱测量。
AI.motivation: 有机非线性光学晶体可用于宽带太赫兹非线性频率转换，但仅有少数晶体兼容电信约1.5 μm泵浦波段，而该波段已有便捷的MHz重复率飞秒光纤激光器；本文旨在展示该波段下超宽带太赫兹产生与探测方案。
AI.method: 采用苯并吲哚鎓碘化物（benzoindolium iodide，MBI，C24H24NOI）晶体，由1.5 μm、MHz重复率光纤激光器照射，开展超宽带太赫兹产生与探测，并在200 mW平均泵浦功率下进行时域光谱测量。
AI.result: 实现了1–30 THz的超宽带太赫兹产生与探测；在200 mW平均泵浦功率下输出约1 μW太赫兹辐射，表现为覆盖整个发射区域的准离散峰，其中11.8 THz处有显著峰；数分钟积分即可获得动态范围大于40 dB的高动态范围时域光谱。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，MBI晶体结合1.5 μm、MHz重复率光纤激光可实现超宽带太赫兹产生与探测，并支持快速、高动态范围的时域光谱测量；摘要未提供转换效率、长期稳定性及具体探测配置等细节。

title: Stable recurrences of the super-transition array formalism from marked generating functions
summary: The conventional evaluation of super-transition-array (STA) mean energies and variances uses partition recurrences with alternating terms that can lose numerical accuracy. Here we apply a marked-generating-function approach to derive coupled coefficient recurrence relations that avoid these sums and directly accumulate fixed-occupation partition functions and arbitrary-order moments of the configuration-average (centroid) transition energies. Unlike explicit expansions into products of subshell occupations, the resulting recurrences require only one coefficient numerator per moment order. The same approach provides recurrences for polynomial occupation-number averages, which can be contracted to obtain the contributions of individual configurations to the STA variance and the Boltzmann energy correction entering the partition function. These contractions avoid the explicit evaluation of individual occupation-product averages and reduce the number of auxiliary quantities required. Numerical examples demonstrate agreement with direct configuration enumeration, including regimes where the alternating Bar--Shalom recurrences lose accuracy. Complementary hole-counting recurrences are also derived for all quantities, starting from a full supershell.

AI.tldr: 提出用标记生成函数推导耦合系数递推，以更稳定地计算 STA 平均能量、方差及相关占据数平均；数值例子与直接组态枚举一致，包括 Bar--Shalom 交替递推失准的情形，并给出空穴计数递推。
AI.motivation: 传统 STA 平均能量和方差通过含交替项的分区递推评估，可能损失数值精度；因此需要避免这些求和、提高数值可靠性并减少辅助量。
AI.method: 采用标记生成函数方法推导耦合系数递推关系，避免交替求和，直接累积固定占据数配分函数和任意阶组态平均（质心）跃迁能量矩；与显式展开为子壳层占据数乘积不同，每阶矩只需一个系数分子。还推导多项式占据数平均的递推，并收缩得到各个组态对 STA 方差及进入配分函数的 Boltzmann 能量修正的贡献；收缩避免显式计算单个占据数乘积平均并减少辅助量。另从全满超壳层出发推导所有量的互补空穴计数递推。
AI.result: 数值例子显示与直接组态枚举一致，包括交替 Bar--Shalom 递推失去精度的情形；摘要未给出具体误差量级、计算复杂度或性能提升数值。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过避免交替求和和显式占据数乘积平均，为 STA 平均能量、方差及相关量提供数值上更可靠、辅助量更少的递推计算途径，并补充空穴计数版本；摘要未提供实现细节和定量比较。

title: Electronic bridge for the $J=0$ state and effects of electrons on frequency and lifetime of the nuclear clock transition in $^{229}$Th$^{2+}$ ion
summary:
We investigate the electronic bridge (EB) process for excitation of the $^{229}$Th nuclear isomer in Th III ions initially prepared in the metastable electronic state with $J=0$. This state is of particular interest for developing a nuclear clock with suppressed electronic hyperfine interactions. Using a combination of configuration interaction and coupled-cluster methods, we calculate EB transition rates for several excitation schemes involving one or two laser fields. We express the rates in terms of the enhancement factor $R$, defined as the ratio of the EB transition rate to the direct nuclear M1 transition rate. Schemes that return the ion to its initial $J=0$ state have relatively small enhancement factors, $R \sim 1$. However, allowing the final electronic state to differ from the initial state produces a strong resonant enhancement: $R$ reaches $5\times10^3$.
  In addition, we calculate the shift in the nuclear transition frequency caused by changing the electronic state from the ground state to two excited metastable states. We also examine how the electronic state affects the nuclear transition lifetime and calculate the probabilities of electron transitions induced by nuclear decay. The EB mechanism shortens the nuclear decay lifetime by a factor of 2.6 when the electrons are initially in the ground state and by a factor of 6.85 when they are in the metastable $J=0$ state.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 Th III 离子中 229Th 核同质异能素在初始亚稳电子态 J=0 下的电子桥激发过程，计算不同激光激发方案下的跃迁速率、核跃迁频移与寿命变化。
AI.motivation: 目标是为开发受电子超精细相互作用抑制的核钟提供依据，因此关注初始制备于 J=0 亚稳电子态的 229Th 核同质异能素激发。
AI.method: 结合组态相互作用与耦合簇方法，计算涉及一个或两个激光场的多种激发方案的电子桥跃迁速率，并以增强因子 R（电子桥跃迁速率与直接核 M1 跃迁速率之比）表示；同时计算电子态从基态变为两个激发亚稳态时的核跃迁频率移动，并考察电子态对核跃迁寿命及核衰变诱导电子跃迁概率的影响。
AI.result: 使离子回到初始 J=0 态的方案增强因子较小，约为 R~1；若允许最终电子态不同于初始态，则出现强共振增强，R 可达 5×10^3。电子桥机制使核衰变寿命缩短：电子初始处于基态时缩短 2.6 倍，处于亚稳 J=0 态时缩短 6.85 倍。
AI.conclusion: 允许最终电子态改变可显著增强 229Th 同质异能素激发；电子态还会明显影响核跃迁频率与寿命，这些结果对基于 Th III 的核钟研究具有直接意义。

title: A branchless single-precision Voigt approximation for spectral synthesis
comment: Accepted for publication in J. Quant. Spectrosc. Radiat. Transf. 10 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Fortran module implementing the QLG members included as ancillary file
summary: The Voigt function is evaluated repeatedly in spectral synthesis, and several widely used implementations carry an absolute error floor. We construct QLG, a family of branchless, single-precision approximations, separable in the damping parameter $a$. QLG is named for its three ingredients: Lorentzian and Gaussian generators $L$ and $G$, and an envelope $q$ that multiplies every fitted correction and vanishes at both endpoints. The leading Lorentzian wing amplitude is fixed analytically. Three members reach observed maximum full-profile relative errors of $6.5\times10^{-3}$, $9.2\times10^{-4}$, and $7\times10^{-5}$ over $a\in[10^{-9},10^{9}]$ and $|v|\le10^{5}$. Extended-domain and randomized checks support these error levels. For the tested SIU, MOOG, and Humlicek w4 implementations, the relative error instead approaches 100% towards small values of the damping parameter. We compare synthesis-weighted costs on an Apple M1 and an AMD EPYC 9554 using gfortran 15, and propagate errors through solar-dwarf, red-supergiant, and M-dwarf syntheses. The least expensive member costs 0.98-1.05 times as much as the tabulated Synspec kernel on the M1 and 1.11-1.20 times as much on the EPYC, with a maximum flux error smaller by a factor of 3.6. The intermediate member costs less than every tested arithmetic kernel and holds the flux error below $10^{-3}$. The most accurate member costs 1.6-3.0 times less than w4 and gives 3.4-5.0 times smaller maximum flux errors in the tested syntheses.

AI.tldr: 论文提出QLG——一族无分支、单精度、可按阻尼参数a分离的Voigt函数近似；它由Lorentzian生成器L、Gaussian生成器G和在每个拟合修正上相乘且在两端点归零的包络q构成。三个成员在a∈[10^-9,10^9]和|v|≤10^5上达到观测最大全剖面相对误差6.5×10^-3、9.2×10^-4和7×10^-5，并在Apple M1与AMD EPYC 9554上比较合成加权成本及太阳矮星、红超巨星和M矮星合成中的通量误差。
AI.motivation: Voigt函数在光谱合成中被反复计算，而若干广泛使用的实现存在绝对误差下限；对测试的SIU、MOOG和Humlicek w4实现，当阻尼参数较小时相对误差反而接近100%。因此需要同时具备高精度和低计算成本的Voigt近似。
AI.method: 构造QLG近似族：无分支、单精度、对阻尼参数a可分离；以Lorentzian和Gaussian生成器L、G及包络q为三要素，q乘每个拟合修正并在两端点消失，主导Lorentzian翼振幅由解析方式固定。在a∈[10^-9,10^9]、|v|≤10^5上评估误差，并进行扩展域与随机化检查；使用gfortran 15在Apple M1和AMD EPYC 9554上比较合成加权成本，并将误差传播到太阳矮星、红超巨星和M矮星合成中，与SIU、MOOG、Humlicek w4、Synspec表格核及算术核比较。
AI.result: 三个QLG成员的最大全剖面相对误差分别为6.5×10^-3、9.2×10^-4和7×10^-5；扩展域和随机化检查支持这些误差水平。成本最低成员在M1上成本为表格化Synspec核的0.98–1.05倍、在EPYC上为1.11–1.20倍，同时最大通量误差小3.6倍；中间成员成本低于所有测试的算术核，通量误差低于10^-3；最准确成员成本比w4低1.6–3.0倍，在测试合成中的最大通量误差小3.4–5.0倍。
AI.conclusion: QLG以可分离、无分支的单精度形式提供可分级精度，并在测试中避免小阻尼参数下接近100%的相对误差；其成员在成本和通量误差之间给出有竞争力的折中，适用于光谱合成中的Voigt函数计算。

title: Stokes flow in a wedge with a moving contact point: well-posedness with a fixed contact angle and Navier slip
summary: We study 2D Stokes flow in a wedge-like region bounded by a solid substrate with Navier slip and by a free surface driven by surface tension. The two meet at a moving contact point with a fixed contact angle. This is the model of a moving contact line at scales below the slip length, in its simplest setting. The slip length is the only length scale, and nothing is prescribed at the contact point beyond the angle: no relaxation law for the angle, and no contact-point dissipation. Slip removes the paradox found by Huh and Scriven, the infinite dissipation at a contact line that moves without slip, but in this model a weaker singularity remains. We give, to our knowledge, the first rigorous characterisation of this singularity for solutions of the free-boundary problem near the stationary state. For small contact angles and small initial data satisfying two compatibility conditions, we prove local existence, uniqueness and Lipschitz dependence on the data. The compatibility conditions are the price of the fixed angle for solutions regular in time up to the initial time. Rather than hiding the singularity, the solution class carries it explicitly in corner expansions. The velocity is continuous up to the contact point. The pressure has a logarithmic singularity, the slip-regularised version of that of Huh and Scriven. Its coefficient is proportional to the contact-point velocity. The slope of the free boundary has a corresponding logarithmic correction, the slip-scale counterpart of the Cox-Voinov relation. The linearised problem combines terms of different scaling, which prevents a direct treatment by the Mellin transform. We solve it by a Lax-Milgram argument, and an auxiliary test function problem shows that the variational solution satisfies the equations. Explicit Mellin representations then yield the corner expansions, and the nonlinear problem is solved by a contraction argument.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带Navier滑移的固体基底与受表面张力驱动的自由表面所围楔形区域中的二维Stokes流，接触点以固定接触角移动；在接触点不额外给定松弛律或耗散，仅以滑移长度为唯一尺度，严格刻画自由边界问题在稳态附近的弱奇异性，并在小接触角、小初始数据及两个相容性条件下证明局部适定性与解的正则结构。
AI.motivation: 该模型是滑移长度以下尺度移动接触线的最简设置；滑移消除了Huh和Scriven指出的无滑移移动接触线处无限耗散悖论，但仍留下较弱奇异性。作者旨在据其所知首次对自由边界问题解在稳态附近的这一奇异性给出严格刻画，并且不在接触点引入角度松弛律或接触点耗散。
AI.method: 在楔形区域中建立由Navier滑移固体基底、表面张力驱动自由表面及固定接触角移动接触点组成的二维Stokes自由边界问题。对小接触角和小初始数据，在满足两个相容性条件下证明局部存在性、唯一性和对数据的Lipschitz依赖性。线性化问题因不同量纲项耦合而不能直接使用Mellin变换，作者改用Lax-Milgram论证，并通过辅助检验函数问题证明变分解满足方程；随后用显式Mellin表示得到角点展开，再用收缩论证求解非线性问题。
AI.result: 证明所得解类显式包含角点奇异性：速度连续到接触点；压力具有对数奇异性，是Huh-Scriven奇异性的滑移正则化版本，其系数与接触点速度成正比；自由边界斜率具有相应的对数修正，是Cox-Voinov关系的滑移尺度对应形式。还得到小接触角、小初始数据下满足两个相容性条件的局部存在性、唯一性及Lipschitz数据依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 固定接触角要求解在初始时刻前时间正则时付出两个相容性条件；作者没有隐藏奇异性，而是通过角点展开将其显式纳入解类。该工作据作者所知首次严格刻画该滑移正则化移动接触线自由边界问题在稳态附近的弱奇异性，并表明速度连续、压力对数奇异及自由边界斜率对数修正构成其核心渐近结构。

title: Generating Circularly Polarized and Chiral Cathodoluminescence from a Single Plasmonic Nanoantenna
summary: The generation and control of circularly polarized and chiral light is important for a wide range of applications, from sensing to optical communication and catalysis. Generally, the generation of chiral light emission from plasmonic nanostructures relies on the use of nanoantennas with predefined chiral shape, which requires complex nanofabrication. In this work, we show how localized electron excitation controls the generation of circularly polarized- and chiral cathodoluminescence from a single achiral plasmonic nanoantenna. We exploit the $π$/2 phase difference between the transverse and longitudinal components of the electric field that is carried by 30 keV electrons, to coherently excite degenerate dipolar modes of which the far-field radiation interferes in the far field, thereby creating a strong optical spin-Hall effect. Using angle-resolved cathodoluminescence polarimetry we measure the angle-resolved Stokes parameters for selected positions of the electron beam near the nanoparticle and show how the precise location of the electron beam controls the generation of the circularly polarized and chiral electric field components. Our findings represent an elemental form of generation of circularly polarized light, by synthesizing the circularly rotating electric fields characteristic for CPL from interference of orthogonal dipolar modes with controlled phase lag.

AI.tldr: 该文报道利用30 keV电子的局域激发，在单个无手性等离激元纳米天线中产生并调控圆偏振与手性阴极发光；通过电子束位置选择激发简并偶极模式并利用其远场干涉，实现强光学自旋霍尔效应，并用角度分辨阴极发光偏振测量验证。
AI.motivation: 圆偏振光和手性光的产生与调控在传感、光通信和催化等领域具有重要应用；但等离激元纳米结构产生手性发光通常依赖预设手性形状的纳米天线，需要复杂纳米加工。本文旨在探索无需手性纳米结构、通过局域电子激发控制单个无手性纳米天线手性发光的方法。
AI.method: 利用30 keV电子所携带电场中横向与纵向分量之间的π/2相位差，相干激发单个无手性等离激元纳米天线的简并偶极模式，并使其远场辐射发生干涉以产生强光学自旋霍尔效应；采用角度分辨阴极发光偏振测量，在纳米颗粒附近选取不同电子束位置，测量角度分辨斯托克斯参量。
AI.result: 研究表明电子束的精确位置能够控制圆偏振和手性电场分量的产生；在单个无手性等离激元纳米天线上实现了圆偏振与手性阴极发光，并观察到强光学自旋霍尔效应。摘要未提供纳米颗粒材料、尺寸、工作波长、发光效率及偏振度等具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为该工作构成一种基本的圆偏振光产生方式：通过控制相位差，使正交偶极模式的干涉合成具有圆旋转电场的圆偏振光；其核心优势是无需预设手性形状的纳米天线和复杂纳米加工。摘要未给出该方法的效率上限、宽带适用性及实际器件集成验证。

title: Learning Similarity-Reduced Ion Kinetics across Scales and Regimes in Capacitively Coupled Plasmas
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to Applied Physics Letters
summary: Systematic kinetic investigations of discharge-mode and heating-mechanism transitions in low-pressure capacitively coupled plasmas (CCPs) are computationally expensive because particle-in-cell/Monte Carlo collision (PIC/MCC) simulations must resolve the inherently slow ion relaxation.In this Letter, we propose a similarity-reduced ion-kinetic representation and a machine learning (ML) reconstruction method for weakly ionized Boltzmann-Poisson discharge systems.Using discharge similarity, the three-dimensional control parameter space, comprising gas pressure p, gap distance d, and driving frequency f, is reduced into a two-dimensional similarity space (pd, fd).A dual-branch ML model predicts the ion density profile at the reference scale and the conditional ion velocity distribution.Taking a 1D3V argon discharge as the paradigm, we use the reconstructed ion kinetic state to initialize the PIC/MCC simulation, which then relaxes to a self-consistent periodic steady state after only a brief evolution.Compared to conventional uniform initializations, this approach achieves a maximum computational speedup of 56.8 times and a median speedup of 27.7 times.Furthermore, the physical regimes of complex nonlinear discharge transitions, including the alpha--gamma mode transition, local-to-nonlocal electron collisional heating mode transition and low-density jumps, are accurately mapped within the similarity space.Similarity transformations extend these boundaries across scales, opening a new avenue for rapid kinetic characterization and optimization of radio-frequency plasma sources.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于放电相似性的离子动理学降维表示与机器学习重建方法，将气压p、间隙d、驱动频率f构成的三维控制参数空间约化为(pd, fd)二维相似空间；双分支ML模型预测参考尺度离子密度剖面与条件离子速度分布，并用重建的离子动理学状态初始化PIC/MCC，从而显著加速周期性稳态求解，同时用于映射多种非线性放电转变边界。
AI.motivation: 低气压电容耦合等离子体中放电模式与加热机制转变的系统动理学研究计算成本很高，因为PIC/MCC模拟必须解析本质上缓慢的离子弛豫过程；作者希望降低这类模拟的计算代价，并实现射频等离子体源的快速动理学表征与优化。
AI.method: 作者利用放电相似性，将三维控制参数空间(p, d, f)约化为二维相似空间(pd, fd)，构建相似性约化的离子动理学表示和机器学习重建方法；采用双分支ML模型预测参考尺度上的离子密度剖面及条件离子速度分布。以1D3V氩放电为范例，用重建的离子动理学状态初始化PIC/MCC模拟，使其经过短暂演化后弛豫到自洽的周期性稳态，并与常规均匀初始化进行比较。
AI.result: 与常规均匀初始化相比，该方法最大计算加速为56.8倍，中位加速为27.7倍；在相似空间内准确映射了α–γ模式转变、局域到非局域电子碰撞加热模式转变以及低密度跳变等复杂非线性放电转变的物理区域，并表明相似变换可将这些边界扩展到不同尺度。摘要未提供误差指标、实验验证或更广泛参数适用性的具体细节。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，相似性约化结合机器学习重建可为PIC/MCC提供有效的离子动理学初始化，大幅缩短达到自洽周期稳态所需的计算时间，并能在相似空间中刻画和跨尺度扩展复杂放电转变边界，为射频等离子体源的快速动理学表征与优化提供了新途径。

title: Parity nonconservation in hyperfine transitions of hydrogen-like muonic atoms
summary: We investigate parity nonconservation (PNC) in the $2s_{1/2}(F=0)\leftrightarrow 2s_{1/2}(F=1)$ hyperfine transition of hydrogenlike muonic $^{13}\mathrm{C}^{5+}$ and $^{15}\mathrm{N}^{6+}$. Finite-nuclear-size effects and the Uehling potential are incorporated directly into the Dirac equation, whereas the leading kinematic-recoil and Fermi--Breit hyperfine corrections to the energy levels are treated to first order in perturbation theory. The spin-independent PNC amplitude is evaluated using hyperfine-resolved energy denominators and is proportional to the weak charge $Q_W$. The spin-dependent amplitude is proportional to $κ=κ_a+κ_Z$, where $κ_a$ and $κ_Z$ denote the nuclear-anapole and direct neutral-current couplings, respectively. For absorption we obtain the PNC degree $\mathcal P_{\rm abs}(^{13}\mathrm{C})=-5.9\times10^{-8}Q_W +1.3\times10^{-5}κ$ and $\mathcal P_{\rm abs}(^{15}\mathrm{N})=-8.8\times10^{-9}Q_W -8.1\times10^{-6}κ$. Nuclear-structure calculations indicate that $^{13}\mathrm{C}$ has enhanced relative sensitivity to direct $Z^0$-boson exchange, whereas the spin-dependent interaction in $^{15}\mathrm{N}$ is expected to be dominated by the nuclear-anapole contribution. In an idealized cavity-polarimetry model, a column density of order $10^{15}~\mathrm{cm^{-2}}$ is required; however, the production of metastable hydrogenlike muonic ions remains the principal experimental challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文研究类氢μ子离子 13C5+ 与 15N6+ 的 2s1/2(F=0)↔2s1/2(F=1) 超精细跃迁中的宇称不守恒，计算自旋无关与自旋相关振幅及吸收宇称不守恒度，并讨论实验可行性。
AI.motivation: 旨在通过类氢μ子离子的超精细跃迁研究宇称不守恒，区分与弱电荷 Q_W 相关的自旋无关效应和与 κ=κ_a+κ_Z 相关的自旋相关效应，并利用核结构差异评估不同同位素对直接 Z0 玻色子交换和核-anapole 耦合的相对敏感性。
AI.method: 将有限核尺寸效应和 Uehling 势直接纳入 Dirac 方程，并将领头运动学反冲与 Fermi–Breit 超精细修正按一阶微扰处理；采用超精细分辨的能量分母计算宇称不守恒振幅。自旋无关振幅正比于弱电荷 Q_W，自旋相关振幅正比于 κ=κ_a+κ_Z。还使用理想化腔体偏振测量模型评估所需柱密度。
AI.result: 得到吸收过程的宇称不守恒度：P_abs(13C)=-5.9×10^-8 Q_W+1.3×10^-5 κ，P_abs(15N)=-8.8×10^-9 Q_W-8.1×10^-6 κ。核结构计算表明 13C 对直接 Z0 玻色子交换的相对灵敏度增强，而 15N 的自旋相关相互作用预期由核-anapole 贡献主导。理想化腔体偏振模型要求约 10^15 cm^-2 的柱密度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了这两种类氢μ子离子中宇称不守恒的可观测量的理论预测，并揭示同位素依赖的灵敏度差异；主要实验挑战是制备亚稳态类氢μ子离子，摘要未提供实际测量结果或详细误差预算。

title: Orbital differentiation in a rare earth ion near half filling
summary: In the electronic structure of rare earth ions, details can be crucial for understanding the origin of correlated states. Currently, state-of-the-art wavefunction-based methods (e.g. CASSCF) can capture single-ion properties of molecular magnets and some band insulating systems, but are expensive to perform, and cannot be applied to metallic systems. Here, we carry out full multiplet calculations for SmN with the cubic rock-salt structure using the crystal field software Quanty. The calculated experimental observables from our model agree precisely with magnetic susceptibility and inelastic neutron scattering experiments, and the spatially resolved spin density also agrees with DFT predictions. By tuning the crystal field parameters, our full multiplet-derived wavefunctions reveal the presence of orbital differentiation of the ground $J=\frac{5}{2}$ manifold into two groups, which are distinct subspaces with different orbital stiffness. This violation of Hund's rule, observed with a fast and inexpensive calculation tool, represents a step forward for microscopic models of rare earth materials, and may provide support for the claim of unconventional triplet superconductivity in SmN.

AI.tldr: 本文用 Quanty 对立方岩盐结构 SmN 做全多重态计算，结果与磁化率和非弹性中子散射实验精确吻合，自旋密度与 DFT 一致；调节晶场参数后发现基态 J=5/2 流形发生轨道分化，形成两个具有不同轨道刚度的子空间，表现为对 Hund 规则的违反。
AI.motivation: 稀土离子电子结构细节对理解关联态起源至关重要；现有 CASSCF 等波函数方法虽能描述分子磁体单离子性质和部分能带绝缘体，但计算昂贵且不能用于金属体系，因此需要快速、廉价且可处理金属体系的微观模型工具。
AI.method: 采用晶体场软件 Quanty 对立方岩盐结构 SmN 进行全多重态计算，并将模型给出的实验可观测量与磁化率和非弹性中子散射实验比较，同时将空间分辨自旋密度与 DFT 预测比较；还通过调节晶场参数分析基态波函数和轨道性质。
AI.result: 计算结果与磁化率和非弹性中子散射实验精确吻合，空间分辨自旋密度也与 DFT 预测一致；调节晶场参数后，全多重态波函数显示基态 J=5/2 流形分化为两组，形成具有不同轨道刚度的不同子空间，构成对 Hund 规则的违反。摘要未提供具体数值、晶场参数或定量误差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明快速且廉价的全多重态计算可用于稀土材料微观建模，所揭示的轨道分化和 Hund 规则违反为理解 SmN 的关联电子行为提供了依据，并可能支持 SmN 中存在非常规三重态超导性的主张。

title: A conditional quadrature method of moments for populations of oblate spheroidal particles
summary: Non-spherical particle populations are encountered in numerous industrial processes, where particle size, shape, and velocity jointly influence transport, breakage, and classification dynamics. The resulting coupled distributions of geometric and kinematic particle properties evolve within a high-dimensional phase space whose accurate representation remains a significant challenge. We present a conditional quadrature method of moments (CQMOM) for oblate spheroidal particles described by a five-dimensional phase space that includes their size, aspect ratio, and velocity. The dimensionality of the problem is reduced by assuming that the particles continuously adopt their drag-maximizing orientation. In the solution algorithm, the resulting conditional quadrature representation of the particle phase space is combined with a Strang splitting of the continuous and discontinuous mathematical operators governing the moment transport. We verify this CQMOM framework against Monte Carlo simulations of the same particle model for representative test cases of increasing complexity, including drag, breakage, recoil, and attrition, at different Stokes numbers. With two nodes per coordinate, the particle number, the mean size, and the mean aspect ratio agree with the Monte Carlo solution within its statistical uncertainty, and the velocity statistics to within 7 %. Time-step and quadrature resolution studies identify the conditional velocity quadrature as the main source of the remaining deviations, for which we discuss potential remedies. Overall, the results demonstrate that the conditional quadrature representation preserves the geometric-kinematic correlations of the particle population in a five-dimensional phase space, at a cost more than 60 times lower than that of a single Monte Carlo realization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向扁椭球颗粒的 CQMOM 框架，在五维相空间中联合描述粒径、长宽比和速度，并用蒙特卡洛模拟验证其精度与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 工业过程中广泛存在非球形颗粒群体，颗粒尺寸、形状和速度会共同影响输运、破碎和分级等动力学；这些几何与运动学性质的耦合分布在高维相空间中演化，如何准确表征仍是显著挑战。
AI.method: 针对扁椭球颗粒构建包含尺寸、长宽比和速度的五维相空间 CQMOM；假设颗粒持续采取阻力最大化取向以降低问题维度；将条件求积表示与对连续和不连续数学算子的 Strang 分裂相结合来求解矩输运方程；并针对阻力、破碎、回弹和磨蚀等递增复杂度算例，在不同 Stokes 数下与同颗粒模型的蒙特卡洛模拟对比，同时开展时间步和求积分辨率研究。
AI.result: 每个坐标采用两个节点时，颗粒数、平均尺寸和平均长宽比与蒙特卡洛解的差异处于其统计不确定性范围内，速度统计量差异在 7% 以内；时间步与求积分辨率研究表明条件速度求积是剩余偏差的主要来源，并讨论了潜在改进措施；该方法的计算成本比单次蒙特卡洛实现低 60 倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，条件求积表示能够在五维相空间中保留颗粒群体的几何—运动学相关性，并以显著低于单次蒙特卡洛实现的计算成本获得与蒙特卡洛统计不确定性相符的主要统计量；剩余偏差主要与条件速度求积有关，需进一步改进。

title: Quantum differential interference contrast microscope
summary: Optical sensing and imaging of transparent unstained biological and material specimen makes use of optical interference to translate phase shifts into intensity measurements, that are readily available in the optical domain. This is the case of Differential Interference Contrast (DIC) microscopes. However, environmental disturbances such as acoustic vibrations, air currents, temperature shifts, and mechanical drifts cause random phase noise that degrades the precision attainable in the estimation of the unknown phase shift. Although there are tools to compensate for these random phase drifts, such using common path interference techniques or phase stabilization systems, these are not always an option and its introduction is generally at the expense of device simplicity and robustness. Here we introduce a quantum version of Differential Interference Contrast microscopy (qDIC), that makes use of quantum interference for polarization analysis. When compared with standard schemes that make use of coherent light, our approach shows that the transfer of classical DIC microscopy into the quantum domain offers a route towards quantum-enhanced resilience to environmental disturbances, allowing the enhancement of phase sensitivity without sacrificing the simplicity and robustness of the optical setup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出量子差分干涉对比显微镜（qDIC），利用量子干涉进行偏振分析，以提升透明无染色样品相位测量对环境扰动的鲁棒性和相位灵敏度。
AI.motivation: 传统DIC显微镜通过光学干涉将相位变化转换为强度测量，但声振动、气流、温度变化和机械漂移等环境扰动会引入随机相位噪声，降低未知相移估计精度；现有共路干涉或相位稳定等补偿方案并非总是可用，且通常牺牲设备简单性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 作者将经典DIC显微镜推广到量子域，提出qDIC，并采用量子干涉进行偏振分析；与使用相干光的标准方案进行比较。
AI.result: 摘要指出，与标准相干光方案相比，qDIC展现出量子增强的环境扰动鲁棒性，可在不牺牲光学装置简单性和鲁棒性的情况下增强相位灵敏度；摘要未提供具体实验参数或定量灵敏度提升数据。
AI.conclusion: 将经典DIC显微镜转入量子域为增强相位测量对环境扰动的鲁棒性提供了途径，并能在保持光学系统简单、稳健的同时提升相位灵敏度。

title: Energy partition in resonant instabilities in multi-component plasmas
summary: Space and astrophysical plasmas are often collisionless and exhibit non-equilibrium velocity distributions. When these departures from equilibrium are sufficiently large, the plasma becomes unstable to various kinetic micro-instabilities, which provide a mechanism for transferring energy from the particles to the electromagnetic (EM) fields. In multi-component plasmas, different species interact with the generated EM waves in distinct ways, acting as sources or sinks of wave energy through resonant wave--particle interactions. Consequently, the nonlinear evolution of kinetic instabilities is governed not only by the species driving the instability but also by the resonant response of other plasma populations. In this work, considering proton-$α$-particle plasmas with parameters representative of the solar wind, we investigate the generation, saturation, and energy partition of kinetic micro-instabilities, such as Alfvén/ion-cyclotron and fast-magnetosonic/whistler wave instabilities. We combine linear Vlasov--Maxwell theory and hybrid particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations to analyze these instabilities and to quantify the exchange of energy and momentum between ion populations during the instability evolution. Our results demonstrate that minor ions play a fundamental role in regulating the nonlinear saturation of kinetic instabilities and the transfer of energy among plasma populations.

AI.tldr: 论文结合线性Vlasov–Maxwell理论与混合粒子网格（PIC）模拟，研究太阳风参数下质子-α粒子等离子体中Alfvén/离子回旋和快磁声/哨声等动理学微观不稳定性，重点分析其激发、饱和及能量分配，发现次要离子对非线性饱和和能量转移具有关键调控作用。
AI.motivation: 空间和天体物理等离子体常为无碰撞体系并具有非平衡速度分布；偏离平衡足够大时会激发动理学微观不稳定性，使粒子能量转移到电磁场。多组分等离子体中不同粒子种类通过共振波-粒子相互作用充当波能来源或汇，因此不稳定性的非线性演化不仅取决于驱动不稳定的粒子，也取决于其他等离子体成分的共振响应。
AI.method: 针对具有太阳风代表性参数的质子-α粒子等离子体，采用线性Vlasov–Maxwell理论与混合粒子网格（PIC）模拟相结合的方法，研究Alfvén/离子回旋及快磁声/哨声波等动理学微观不稳定性的激发、饱和与能量分配，并量化不稳定性演化过程中离子种群间的能量和动量交换。
AI.result: 结果表明，次要离子在动理学不稳定性的非线性饱和以及等离子体种群间的能量转移中起基础性/关键作用；摘要未提供具体的增长率、饱和幅度或能量分配比例等定量数值。
AI.conclusion: 在多组分太阳风等离子体中，不能仅考虑驱动不稳定性的主要离子种类，次要离子的共振响应会显著影响动理学不稳定性的非线性饱和与能量传输，因而对理解无碰撞等离子体中的能量分配具有重要意义。

title: Exposing and overcoming the polarizability pathology of the Fermi-Omont pseudopotential
comment: 18 pages, 11 figures. Submitted to Phys. Rev. A
summary: Any realistic electron-atom or ion-atom potential energy function contains a long-range contribution from the atomic polarizability which gives a $1/r^4$ long-range tail. This modifies the well-known Wigner threshold law for orbital momenta $L>0$, causing these $L\neq 0$ scattering phase shifts to vary linearly in energy instead of as $k^{2L+1}$. The $L>0$ Fermi-Omont zero-range pseudopotentials are erroneously divergent at zero energy due to this modification, a divergence deriving from very long-range physics that should not be incorporated into a Dirac delta function. Here, we investigate some alternative scenario for repairing this pathological behavior to obtain smooth and accurate potential energy curves calculated using the Fermi-Omont pseudopotential concept, with some systematic benchmarking tests for comparison.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，原子极化率产生的1/r^4长程尾会改变L>0时的Wigner阈值律，使L≠0的散射相移随能量线性变化，并使L>0的Fermi-Omont零程赝势在零能处发散；作者探索修复这一病态行为的替代方案，以获得平滑、准确的势能曲线，并开展系统基准测试。
AI.motivation: 真实的电子-原子或离子-原子势包含由原子极化率产生的1/r^4长程项。该长程项会修正L>0的Wigner阈值律，并使Fermi-Omont零程赝势在零能处出现发散；这种发散源于不应被纳入Dirac delta函数描述的长程物理，因此需要修复。
AI.method: 研究若干替代方案，以修复L>0的Fermi-Omont零程赝势在零能处的病态发散，并通过系统基准测试进行比较，从而计算平滑且准确的势能曲线；摘要未给出具体方案细节。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体定量结果或基准测试数据，仅说明开展了替代方案探索和系统基准比较。
AI.conclusion: 摘要未给出明确结论；其目标是修复Fermi-Omont赝势的病态发散，从而获得平滑、准确的势能曲线，具体有效性与结论需见正文。

title: Development and Validation of a preCICE Based OpenMOC OpenFOAM Coupling Framework for Nuclear Reactor Analysis
summary: To address the long computation time required by stochastic solvers, which are applied in the coupled neutronics-thermal hydraulics (N-TH) calculations, a faster N-TH coupling framework is developed based on the multiphysics coupling library preCICE, which enables data exchange between OpenMOC and OpenFOAM. As an alternative to commonly used stochastic solvers, like OpenMC, OpenMOC is used as a neutronics solver providing much faster steady-state solution in a Picard iteration. To realize this coupling strategy, OpenMC is used for an initial one-time computation cost for multi-group cross sections data generation that is used throughout OpenMOC calculations. A preCICE library adapter for OpenMOC is also developed, allowing data exchange between neutronic power distributions and thermal hydraulic temperature fields. Our proposed coupling framework is validated through simulations of a simplified 2 times 2 fuel assembly, and a quartered geometry of 17 times 17 fuel assembly. The comparison shows good agreement with established referenced solutions, highlighting our proposed coupling framework for the steady-state N-TH coupling at a fraction of the time required by stochastic solver codes. This advantages could be extended for future applications where fast approximated solutions are required to address the change of N-TH coupling due to small parametric changes like in digital twin of nuclear reactor.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于preCICE的OpenMOC-OpenFOAM快速稳态中子学-热工水力耦合框架，利用OpenMC一次性生成多群截面，并在简化2×2燃料组件及17×17燃料组件四分之一几何上验证；结果与参考解吻合，计算时间显著低于随机求解器。
AI.motivation: 随机求解器在耦合中子学-热工水力计算中计算时间过长，因此需要更快的耦合框架；该框架还面向数字孪生等需快速近似解、且由小参数变化引起N-TH耦合变化的未来应用。
AI.method: 基于多物理场耦合库preCICE实现OpenMOC与OpenFOAM之间的数据交换；采用OpenMOC作为中子学求解器，在Picard迭代中提供更快的稳态解；使用OpenMC进行一次性的多群截面数据生成，供OpenMOC计算全程使用；开发OpenMOC的preCICE库适配器，用于交换中子功率分布与热工水力温度场；通过简化2×2燃料组件和17×17燃料组件四分之一几何的仿真进行验证。
AI.result: 与已有参考解对比显示良好吻合，表明该耦合框架能以随机求解器代码所需时间的一小部分完成稳态N-TH耦合；摘要未提供具体加速比或误差数值。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的preCICE耦合框架可高效实现稳态中子学-热工水力耦合，并有望扩展到数字孪生等需要快速近似解的场合。

title: Direct Numerical Simulation of Vortex-Induced Instability Over a Semi-Infinite Flat Plate with Discrete Roughness
summary: The receptivity of flow over a semi-infinite flat plate to a combination of deterministic free stream excitation and surface roughness, is investigated by solving the incompressible Navier-Stokes equation (NSE). The free stream excitation is in the form of a convecting vortex with fixed strength and sign, while the roughness element is a Gaussian bump. Two-dimensional (2D) and three-dimensional (3D) direct numerical simulations (DNS) are performed to determine whether the nonmodal nonlinear nature of transition, previously established for the vortex-induced instability in [Sundaram et al., Effects of free stream excitation on the boundary layer over a semi-infinite flat plate, Phys. Fluids, 32, 094110 (2020))], holds in the presence of surface roughness. The study aims to capture the fundamental differences arising due to the addition of surface roughness using instantaneous flow features, vorticity dynamics and application of nonlinear theories of receptivity. Roughness accelerates the transition process significantly, while retaining the indicator of nonmodal response, i.e. the spatio-temporal wave front (STWF). The inherently 2D nature of the vortex-induced instability evolves to three-dimensionality much faster in the presence of roughness, necessitating a 3D framework to capture the effects of roughness accurately. The cumulative response to the surface bump and convecting vortex can be separated into four stages, viz. are (i) generation of vortical disturbances at the roughness, (ii) a spatio-temporal amplification of the disturbance field, (iii) emergence and amplification of the STWF marked by sequence of unsteady separation bubbles, and (iv) emergence of turbulent flow due to merging of the unsteady separation bubbles to turbulent spots.

AI.tldr: 本文通过二维和三维不可压缩Navier-Stokes直接数值模拟，研究半无限平板边界层对 convecting vortex 自由来流激励与高斯凸起表面粗糙度联合作用的感受性。结果表明粗糙度显著加速转捩，但非模态响应标志STWF仍保留；涡致不稳定性的二维特征在粗糙度作用下更快发展出三维性，因此需采用三维框架，并将响应划分为四个阶段。
AI.motivation: 研究半无限平板流动对确定性自由来流激励与表面粗糙度共同作用的感受性，并检验此前针对涡致不稳定性建立的非模态非线性转捩性质在存在表面粗糙度时是否仍成立；同时利用瞬时流动特征、涡量动力学和非线性感受性理论刻画加入粗糙度带来的根本差异。
AI.method: 求解不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程，开展二维和三维直接数值模拟（DNS）。自由来流激励采用强度和符号固定的 convecting vortex，粗糙度元素为高斯凸起；通过瞬时流动特征、涡量动力学以及非线性感受性理论进行分析。
AI.result: 粗糙度显著加速转捩过程，同时保留非模态响应的指示特征，即 spatio-temporal wave front（STWF）。原本具有二维性质的涡致不稳定性在粗糙度存在时更快演化为三维，因而需要三维框架才能准确捕捉粗糙度效应。表面凸起与 convecting vortex 的累积响应可分为四个阶段：(i) 粗糙度处生成涡性扰动；(ii) 扰动场发生时空放大；(iii) 以一系列非定常分离泡为标志的STWF出现并放大；(iv) 非定常分离泡合并为湍流斑并形成湍流。
AI.conclusion: 在自由来流涡激励与表面粗糙度联合作用下，转捩仍表现出非模态非线性特征，STWF可作为该响应的指示标志；粗糙度显著加速转捩并促进三维化，因此准确刻画其效应需要三维框架。累积响应可归纳为从粗糙度处扰动生成、时空放大、STWF及非定常分离泡演化，到湍流斑形成的四阶段过程。摘要未提供定量参数或转捩位置等具体数值。

title: Topological Timing of Bound States by Spacetime Mass Windings
summary: Topology usually determines where a wave is trapped. Here we show that it can also determine when a trapped state brightens or dims. We consider a dimerized photonic lattice in which a real Dirac mass, varying in space, binds a Jackiw-Rebbi state, while staggered gain and loss, switched in time, act as an imaginary Dirac mass on that same state. Together, the two masses form a mass field in space and time whose isolated zeros carry an integer winding. Combining a continuum Dirac description with finite-lattice simulations, we show that the sign of this winding fixes whether the bound state reaches a maximum or a minimum at the switch, while the gain and loss remain below the bulk gap. The windings obey a conservation law: they are created and annihilated in pairs, and their sum along a boundary determines which extrema are protected. Full-wave simulations of a passive waveguide array, in which the propagation distance plays the role of time, reproduce these predictions with loss alone. These results provide a topological handle on the timing of localized optical responses, relevant to switching, gating, and pulse shaping of confined modes in integrated photonic circuits and topological lasers.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并验证了一种时空狄拉克质量场方案，用质量场零点的整数绕数拓扑地控制局域束缚态在开关时刻达到极大值还是极小值。
AI.motivation: 传统上拓扑用于决定波被束缚在何处，作者希望进一步证明拓扑也能决定束缚态何时变亮或变暗，从而为集成光子电路和拓扑激光器中受限模式的开关、门控与脉冲整形提供时间维度的拓扑调控手段。
AI.method: 作者考虑二聚化光子晶格：空间变化的实狄拉克质量束缚Jackiw-Rebbi态，时间切换的交错增益与损耗作为作用在同一态上的虚狄拉克质量；二者构成时空质量场，其孤立零点携带整数绕数。作者结合连续狄拉克描述与有限晶格模拟进行分析，并用无源波导阵列的全波模拟验证，其中传播距离充当时间。
AI.result: 结果表明，绕数的符号决定束缚态在切换时达到最大值还是最小值，同时增益和损耗保持在体带隙以下；绕数满足守恒律，成对产生和湮灭，且沿边界的绕数之和决定哪些极值受到保护。无源波导阵列的全波模拟仅利用损耗即复现了这些预测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了调控局域光响应时序的拓扑方法，可用于集成光子电路和拓扑激光器中受限模式的切换、门控与脉冲整形；摘要未提供具体定量参数或实验数值。

title: Kinetic-Ballooning and Resistive X-Point Dynamics in Quasicontinuous Exhaust Tokamak Plasmas
summary: We investigate quasicoherent modes (QCMs) and their interaction with scrape-off-layer (SOL) plasma blobs (filaments) in the type-I-ELM-free quasicontinuous exhaust (QCE) regime, extending the analysis in [K. Zhang et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 055102 (2026)]. Two-fluid electromagnetic turbulence simulations are compared for two self-consistent turbulence states with different separatrix densities. In both cases, a separatrix-spanning QCM resides within the radial-electric-field well, whereas blobs are observed only in the case with higher separatrix density. The QCM exhibits similar kinetic-ballooning-mode (KBM) signatures in both cases, with modest differences in coherence and harmonic content. The primary difference is the presence of an additional resistive X-point mode (RXM), which emerges as the near-X-point collisionality increases. The coexistence of the KBM and RXM shifts the potential--density cross-phase from its KBM-like value toward the interchange value in the SOL, allowing QCM perturbations to be ejected as blobs. These intermittent blobs account for over half of the net radial $E\times B$ transport in the far SOL. Neither QCM onset nor blob ejection requires an increase in upstream collisionality. The results distinguish the KBM-dominated mechanism that regulates the pedestal from the RXM-assisted blob-launching mechanism that enables intermittent SOL exhaust.

AI.tldr: 该文通过双流体电磁湍流模拟比较两种不同分界面密度的自洽湍流态，研究QCE无ELM regime中准相干模与SOL blob的相互作用，揭示KBM与RXM共存如何促成blob发射及远SOL间歇输运。
AI.motivation: 研究type-I-ELM-free准连续排气（QCE）regime中的准相干模（QCM）及其与刮削层（SOL）等离子体blob（filament）的相互作用，并扩展K. Zhang等（Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 055102, 2026）的分析；重点比较不同分界面密度的自洽湍流态，以厘清QCM、blob发射与碰撞性之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用双流体电磁湍流模拟，对两种具有不同分界面密度的自洽湍流态进行比较；分析跨越分界面的QCM、其KBM特征、相干性和谐波含量，并考察近X点碰撞性增加时出现的电阻X点模（RXM），以及势—密度交叉相位和径向E×B输运。
AI.result: 两种情况下，跨越分界面的QCM均位于径向电场阱内，但blob仅出现在分界面密度较高的情况。两种情况下QCM均表现出相似的KBM特征，相干性和谐波含量仅有 modest差异；主要差异是近X点碰撞性增加时出现额外的RXM。KBM与RXM共存使SOL中的势—密度交叉相位由KBM类值转向interchange值，从而使QCM扰动可作为blob被抛出。这些间歇性blob贡献了远SOL净径向E×B输运的一半以上；QCM起始和blob发射均不要求上游碰撞性增加。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了两种机制：KBM主导的机制调控台基，而RXM辅助的blob发射机制实现间歇性SOL排气。

title: Quantum adiabatic and diabatic optimization: A Hilbert space engineering strategy with Rydberg arrays
summary: Neutral-atom arrays provide a versatile platform for encoding combinatorial optimization problems with arbitrary graph connectivity [Nguyen et al., PRX Quantum 4, 010316 (2023)]. Although the dynamics of individual encoding gadgets has been studied [Bombieri et al., PRX Quantum 6, 020306 (2025)], understanding annealing bottlenecks in larger networks remains challenging. We investigate how engineering the Hilbert-space geometry controls quantum annealing in a family of blockaded-chain models motivated by these encodings. While boundary terms encode the target maximum independent set problem, the bulk geometry induces an auxiliary optimization problem associated with independent sets of cliques. Spectrally, the energetics of the quantum system can be approximated by physically derived clique weights. When the target problem and the auxiliary problems are consistent, the low-energy modes lie predominantly within the target subspace. This spectral structure motivates a diabatic annealing strategy that exploits target-compatible excited states, as tested on the diamond-chain graph family. These results provide a framework for predicting annealing bottlenecks, and demonstrate Hilbert-space engineering as a strategy for improving neutral-atom quantum optimization protocols.

AI.tldr: 本文研究阻塞链模型中希尔伯特空间几何如何控制中性原子量子退火：边界项编码目标最大独立集问题，体几何诱导团独立集辅助问题，并据此提出利用目标兼容激发态的透热退火策略；在菱形链图上验证了相关谱结构与策略，为预测退火瓶颈和改进中性原子量子优化协议提供框架。
AI.motivation: 中性原子阵列可编码具有任意图连通性的组合优化问题，但单个编码器件的动力学虽已有研究，较大网络中的退火瓶颈仍难以理解；本文旨在揭示希尔伯特空间几何对量子退火的控制作用并预测瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建一类受中性原子编码启发的阻塞链模型：边界项编码目标最大独立集问题，体几何诱导与团独立集相关的辅助优化问题；用物理推导的团权重近似量子系统的谱能量学；基于目标问题与辅助问题一致时低能模式主要位于目标子空间的结构，提出利用目标兼容激发态的透热退火策略，并在菱形链图族上测试。
AI.result: 当目标问题与辅助问题一致时，低能模式主要位于目标子空间；量子系统的能量学可由物理推导的团权重近似。所提出的透热退火策略在菱形链图族上得到测试；摘要未提供具体性能提升或数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 结果提供了预测退火瓶颈的框架，并表明希尔伯特空间工程可作为改进中性原子量子优化协议的一种策略。

title: High-Order Regularization for Singular and Nearly Singular Laplace and Stokes Layer Potentials in Two Dimensions
comment: 36 pages, 11 figures; code and data available at https://github.com/han-zhou-math/high-order-reg-2d
summary: Layer potentials represent the solutions of many elliptic boundary value problems, but their kernels have the singularity of the fundamental solution, so standard quadrature loses accuracy at targets on or near the boundary. In two dimensions, Gaussian regularization of the logarithmic kernel gives a smooth kernel involving the exponential integral $E_1$, but for the single layer its regularization error is only first order in the smoothing radius $δ$. We construct modified kernels for two-dimensional Laplace and Stokes single- and double-layer potentials that achieve regularization error $O(δ^p)$, $p=3,5,7$, uniformly for targets on and near the curve. The resulting method is both high-order accurate and easy to implement: the integrals are evaluated directly by the periodic trapezoidal rule on a single fixed set of boundary nodes for all targets. Choosing $δ=c h^q$ with $q<1$, where $h$ is the node spacing, keeps the discretization error smaller than the regularization error as $h\to0$, and numerical experiments confirm the predicted $O(h^{pq})$ convergence. Finally, we combine the near-curve evaluation with a fast Poisson solver to compute the potentials on the entire Cartesian grid.

AI.tldr: 针对二维 Laplace 和 Stokes 单层、双层位势，构造修正核使边界上及边界附近目标的正则化误差达到 O(δ^p)，其中 p=3,5,7；配合固定边界节点上的周期梯形法则和 δ=c h^q（q<1）选取，实现高阶且易实现的计算，并用快速 Poisson 求解器将位势推广到整个 Cartesian 网格。
AI.motivation: 位势核具有基本解的奇异性，标准求积在目标点位于边界上或边界附近时会损失精度；二维对数核的高斯正则化虽得到含指数积分 E1 的光滑核，但单层位势的正则化误差仅为一阶，因此需要构造更高阶的修正核。
AI.method: 构造二维 Laplace 与 Stokes 单层和双层位势的修正核，使正则化误差在曲线上及曲线附近一致达到 O(δ^p)，p=3,5,7；对所有目标点在单一一组固定边界节点上直接用周期梯形法则计算积分；选取 δ=c h^q 且 q<1，其中 h 为节点间距，使离散误差小于正则化误差；再将近曲线求值与快速 Poisson 求解器结合，计算整个 Cartesian 网格上的位势。
AI.result: 所得方法高阶准确且易于实现；当 h→0 时离散误差小于正则化误差，数值实验验证了预测的 O(h^{pq}) 收敛阶；该方法可借助快速 Poisson 求解器在 entire Cartesian grid 上计算位势。
AI.conclusion: 通过高阶修正核、固定边界节点上的周期梯形法则及合适的 δ 尺度选择，可以在边界上及边界附近稳定获得高阶精度的二维 Laplace 和 Stokes 位势；结合快速 Poisson 求解器可扩展到整个 Cartesian 网格，数值结果支持理论收敛阶。

title: Fluid exchange and renewal in the left atrial appendage
summary: Fluid exchange through the opening of a cavity does not uniquely determine how the cavity is washed out. We investigate this phenomenon in the left atrial appendage (LAA), a deforming side cavity of the heart, using simulations of 17 patient-specific atria with wall motion reconstructed from time-resolved computed tomography. Fluid exchange through the LAA ostium is decomposed into a component driven by LAA volume change and a component due to simultaneous bidirectional flow, with no net volume transport. Washout of a scalar initially confined to the LAA is compared with predictions from two well-mixed washout models and assessed alongside residence-time distributions. Volume-driven transport accounts for approximately 24-78% of total exchange across the simulated atria. Relative washout efficiencies are approximately 26-53% with respect to the inflow-driven washout model that assumes scalar-free inflow. A scalar-balance decomposition identifies two contributions to this discrepancy: re-ingestion of previously expelled scalar and preferential export of scalar-poor fluid. Both effects reduce the effective washout rate in every configuration. Residence-time distributions reveal coexisting distinct younger and older fluid regions, and a regional analysis of one appendage localizes the older population predominantly in its distal region. These findings show that substantial exchange across the LAA ostium coexists with prolonged distal retention. Effective renewal depends on how much fluid crosses the ostium and which fluid is exchanged.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用17例患者特异性心房仿真，分析左心耳（LAA）开口流体交换与实际冲刷效率的差异，发现开口交换量大并不等于有效更新，远端滞留可长期存在。
AI.motivation: 流体经腔体开口的交换量不能唯一决定腔体被冲刷的程度；作者旨在以LAA为对象，区分开口交换的构成并评估其对有效冲刷和滞留的影响。
AI.method: 基于时间分辨计算机断层扫描重建心房壁运动，对17例患者特异性心房进行仿真；将LAA开口流体交换分解为由LAA体积变化驱动的分量和同时存在、无净体积输运的双向流动分量；将初始局限于LAA的标量冲刷与两种充分混合冲刷模型预测进行比较，并结合 residence-time 分布评估；通过标量平衡分解识别差异来源。
AI.result: 体积驱动输运约占各仿真心房总交换量的24%–78%；相对冲刷效率约为26%–53%（相对于假设流入不含标量的流入驱动冲刷模型）。标量平衡分解识别出两个造成差异的贡献：先前排出标量的再摄入和标量贫乏流体的优先输出；两者在所有配置中均降低有效冲刷率。Residence-time 分布显示年轻与年老流体区域并存；对其中一个心耳的区域分析显示，较老流体群体主要位于其远端区域。
AI.conclusion: LAA开口存在显著流体交换，但仍可伴随远端长期滞留；有效更新不仅取决于有多少流体跨过开口，也取决于交换的是哪些流体。

title: Dual-Comb Spectrometry Enabled by Gain-Assisted Electro-Optic Fiber Ring Resonators
summary: Broadband dual-comb spectroscopy (DCS) with widely tunable repetition rates and simplified frequency stabilization is desirable for diverse sensing applications. Here, we demonstrate DCS using two gain-assisted fiber ring resonators that share a continuous-wave (CW) laser and incorporate intracavity electro-optic (EO) phase modulation. Intracavity gain compensates for round-trip losses, sustaining repeated phase modulation and enabling flat-top comb spectra with a 20-dB bandwidth exceeding 1.8 THz. Harmonic-order selection provides widely tunable repetition rates from approximately 5 to 0.2 GHz without substantially compromising the spectral bandwidth. The comb phase noise closely follows that of the radio-frequency (RF) drive at low offset frequencies. Without active frequency stabilization, the two combs exhibit an instrument-limited beat-note linewidth of 2 Hz, indicating high mutual coherence. The generated dual combs enable high-speed DCS at the single-interferogram rate, providing a platform for dynamic spectroscopic measurements. This all-fiber architecture, together with its simplified operation, offers a promising route towards compact and readily integrable dual-comb instruments.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种简化的全光纤双梳光谱系统：两个增益辅助光纤环形谐振腔共享连续波激光并采用腔内电光相位调制，实现重复频率约5至0.2 GHz可调、20 dB带宽超过1.8 THz的平坦梳谱，以及无需主动稳频时2 Hz的拍频线宽，可用于单干涉图速率的高速动态光谱测量。
AI.motivation: 宽带双梳光谱在多种传感应用中需要广泛可调的重复频率和简化的频率稳定方案；同时，紧凑、易集成的双梳仪器也是该研究追求的方向。
AI.method: 采用两个共享同一连续波激光器的增益辅助光纤环形谐振腔，并在腔内加入电光相位调制；利用腔内增益补偿往返损耗，以维持重复相位调制并产生平坦梳谱；通过谐波阶数选择调节重复频率；双梳在无主动频率稳定条件下运行。
AI.result: 获得了20 dB带宽超过1.8 THz的平坦顶梳谱；重复频率可在约5至0.2 GHz范围内广泛调节，且频谱带宽未受明显损害；低频偏处梳相位噪声紧密跟随射频驱动；无主动稳频时双梳拍频线宽达到仪器极限的2 Hz，表明具有高互相干性；所生成双梳支持单干涉图速率的高速双梳光谱测量。
AI.conclusion: 该全光纤架构及简化操作方式为紧凑、易集成的双梳仪器和动态光谱测量提供了有前景的技术路线。

title: Collisionality scaling of the tokamak density limit
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for publication in Physical Review Letters
summary: The threshold at which density-limiting plasma instabilities occur in tokamak fusion reactors is not well understood. Here, we present the first large-scale empirical evidence of a common collisionality threshold present across multiple devices and confinement regimes. Machine-learning-guided analysis of a diverse experimental database identifies a scaling in edge effective collisionality ($ν_*$) that bears resemblance to the widely utilized Greenwald limit but yields a substantially lower false positive rate. This threshold decreases with dimensionless pressure ($β$), consistent with theoretical expectations for enhanced transport from electromagnetic effects on resistive ballooning mode turbulence. These results suggest that future burning plasma devices such as ITER and ARC could potentially achieve higher density, and thus fusion power, than previously expected.

AI.tldr: 通过机器学习分析多装置、多约束模式的实验数据库，研究发现托卡马克边缘有效碰撞率存在共同阈值；该阈值类似Greenwald极限但误报率更低，并随无量纲压强β降低，提示ITER和ARC等未来燃烧等离子体装置可能实现更高密度和聚变功率。
AI.motivation: 托卡马克聚变堆中密度限制等离子体不稳定性的阈值尚不清楚，因此需要跨装置、跨约束模式检验是否存在共同的碰撞率阈值，并据此评估未来燃烧等离子体的密度上限。
AI.method: 研究提供首个大规模经验证据，采用机器学习引导的分析方法处理多样化实验数据库，识别边缘有效碰撞率ν*的标度，并将其与Greenwald极限比较假阳性率；同时分析阈值随无量纲压强β的变化，并与电阻性气球模湍流中电磁效应增强输运的理论预期相联系。摘要未提供数据库规模、具体机器学习算法和装置清单等细节。
AI.result: 分析发现多个装置和约束模式中存在共同的碰撞率阈值；所识别的ν*标度与Greenwald极限相似，但假阳性率显著更低；该阈值随β降低，符合电磁效应对电阻性气球模湍流输运增强的理论预期。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，这些结果表明ITER和ARC等未来燃烧等离子体装置可能达到比此前预期更高的密度，从而获得更高的聚变功率。

title: High-order Crank-Nicolson method via diagonal Padé factorization
summary: We present a numerical method to solve the time-dependent Schrödinger equation at arbitrary order of accuracy in the time step, particularly well suited for tridiagonal Hamilton operators. The method is based on a factorization of the diagonal Padé approximants of the matrix exponential into products of linear factors, which preserves tridiagonal matrix structure at every time step and yields a propagator of order 2q in the time step at a cost of O(qN) operations. The propagator is exactly unitary by construction, and at lowest order q=1 it reduces to the standard Crank-Nicolson algorithm. We further extend the method to any Hamiltonian admitting a decomposition into a sum of tridiagonal or diagonal operators via high-order split-operator techniques (McLachlan, 2022), retaining O(qN) scaling at each time step. We also analytically show and numerically verify that the precision is dictated by the split-operator method. This covers a broad range of physically relevant cases, including higher-dimensional systems, higher-order spatial discretizations, and non-separable potentials.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种以时间步长任意阶精度求解含时薛定谔方程的数值方法：将矩阵指数对角 Padé 近似分解为线性因子，保持三对角结构并构造严格幺正传播子；再结合高阶分裂算符推广到可分解为三对角或对角算符之和的哈密顿量，每步计算量为 O(qN)。
AI.motivation: 针对含时薛定谔方程的高阶、保幺正且高效数值求解需求，尤其是三对角哈密顿量情形；并希望将方法推广到更高维系统、高阶空间离散和非可分离势等更广泛物理问题。摘要未给出与其他方法的具体比较数据。
AI.method: 对矩阵指数的对角 Padé 近似进行因子分解，写成线性因子乘积，使每个时间步保持三对角矩阵结构；所得传播子在时间步长上为 2q 阶，计算量为 O(qN)，且按构造严格幺正，q=1 时退化为标准 Crank-Nicolson 算法。进一步利用高阶分裂算符技术，将方法扩展到可分解为三对角或对角算符之和的任意哈密顿量，并保持每步 O(qN) 标度。
AI.result: 解析证明并数值验证：整体精度由分裂算符方法决定。方法覆盖高维系统、高阶空间离散和非可分离势等广泛情形。摘要未提供具体数值误差、算例规模或性能数据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了高阶、严格幺正、O(qN) 每步成本且保持三对角结构的含时薛定谔方程传播子框架，并可借助高阶分裂算符推广到更广泛哈密顿量；在推广情形下，精度受分裂算符方法支配。

title: Symmetry-reduced k-point sampling and Wannier analysis with localized Gaussian orbitals
summary: Brillouin-zone sampling with localized orbitals requires consistent transformations between sparse real-space matrices and complex Bloch states. Symmetry reduces the number of reciprocal-space problems, but scalar integration weights alone cannot reconstruct the matrices and wavefunctions needed for densities and orbital analysis. We develop a unified formulation of these transformations for nonorthogonal Gaussian bases and describe its implementation in CP2K. Atom permutations, local orbital rotations, and lattice phases connect irreducible-point solutions to full symmetry orbits while preserving the overlap metric. Direct and fast lattice transforms couple this construction to self-consistent calculations, including complex orbital optimization and finite-temperature occupations. Gauge-consistent full-mesh orbitals and directed inter-point overlaps support Wannier90 export, Wannier construction, and Hamiltonian interpolation. In silicon and aluminium tests, symmetry reduces a 64-point mesh to four representatives while retaining cell energies or electronic free energies within $1.5\times10^{-12}$ hartree of the unreduced calculation. Hybrid exchange and many-body applications illustrate the additional role of auxiliary bases and transfer momenta. The resulting framework connects symmetry-reduced integration to gauge-consistent analysis of periodic electronic states within a localized-orbital representation.

AI.tldr: 该文针对局域轨道布里渊区采样中稀疏实空间矩阵与复数布洛赫态之间需一致变换的问题，提出统一变换公式并在CP2K中实现，实现对称性约化、规范一致的全网格轨道及Wannier相关分析。
AI.motivation: 布里渊区采样使用局域轨道时，需要在稀疏实空间矩阵和复数布洛赫态之间进行一致变换；仅有标量积分权重无法重建密度和轨道分析所需的矩阵与波函数，因此需要统一的变换框架。
AI.method: 作者为非正交高斯基建立实空间矩阵与布洛赫态之间变换的统一公式，并在CP2K中实现。方法利用原子置换、局域轨道旋转和晶格相位，将不可约点解映射到完整对称轨道，同时保持重叠度规；通过直接和快速晶格变换将其耦合到自洽计算，包括复数轨道优化和有限温度占据；并生成规范一致的全网格轨道与有向点间重叠，以支持Wannier90导出、Wannier构造和哈密顿量插值。
AI.result: 在硅和铝的测试中，对称性将64点网格约化为4个代表点，同时保持晶胞能量或电子自由能与未约化计算的差异在1.5×10^-12 hartree以内。杂化交换和多体应用展示了辅助基与转移动量的额外作用。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将对称性约化积分与周期电子态的规范一致分析连接起来，并可在局域轨道表示中用于相关电子结构分析。

title: Surrogate-Based Optimization of Tandem Twin-Rotor Wind Turbines Accounting for Wake Interactions
summary: Wake interaction in a tandem twin-rotor turbine couples power capture with thrust on the shared support. This study develops a time-resolved surrogate for upstream IEA Wind 22 MW and downstream NREL 5 MW rotors. It covers spacing ratios $0.01\leq L/D\leq0.20$ and tip-speed ratios $4\leqλ\leq11$. Vortex-method simulations of 160 configurations under turbulent inflow train per-time-node XGBoost models to predict 600 s power, thrust, and torque histories. A CNN-Attention-LSTM network extends these histories, and a genetic algorithm balances the system power and thrust coefficients. Ten-fold cross-validation gives median power-history $R^2$ values of 0.995 upstream and 0.958 downstream for unseen configurations, but the first stage cannot extrapolate in tip-speed ratio. With fixed pitch and prescribed rotor speed, the coefficients apply where both rotors reach the simulated tip-speed ratio below rated wind speed. Increasing spacing raises upstream power by up to 6% and lowers downstream power by up to 62%. System power changes by less than 4% at fixed $λ$. The high-power end of the Pareto front lies near $λ=10$. At $L/D=0.20$, the system power coefficient is highest. This configuration has the lowest peak thrust among the high-power candidates.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对串联双转子（上游IEA Wind 22 MW、下游NREL 5 MW）构建时间分辨代理模型，在0.01≤L/D≤0.20、4≤λ≤11范围内用涡方法仿真160种配置，以逐时间节点XGBoost预测600 s功率、推力和转矩历史，结合CNN-Attention-LSTM扩展历史并用遗传算法平衡系统功率与推力系数；模型对未见配置的功率历史预测精度较高，并揭示间距对上下游功率及高功率候选推力的影响。
AI.motivation: 串联双转子间的尾流相互作用使共享支撑上的功率捕获与推力相互耦合，需要在较宽间距比和叶尖速比范围内快速评估配置，并权衡系统功率与推力。
AI.method: 针对上游IEA Wind 22 MW和下游NREL 5 MW转子建立时间分辨代理模型，覆盖0.01≤L/D≤0.20与4≤λ≤11；在湍流入流下采用涡方法仿真160种配置，训练逐时间节点XGBoost模型预测600 s功率、推力和转矩历史，使用CNN-Attention-LSTM网络扩展这些历史，并用遗传算法平衡系统功率系数与推力系数；采用十折交叉验证评估。
AI.result: 十折交叉验证中，未见配置的功率历史预测中位R²为上游0.995、下游0.958，但第一阶段无法在叶尖速比方向外推。固定桨距和给定转子转速时，所得系数适用于额定风速以下两转子均达到所模拟叶尖速比的情形。增大间距使上游功率最高提高6%、下游功率最高降低62%；固定λ时系统功率变化小于4%。高功率Pareto前沿靠近λ=10；L/D=0.20时系统功率系数最高，且该配置在高功率候选中峰值推力最低。
AI.conclusion: 该代理模型对训练范围内未见配置具有较高的功率历史预测精度，但受叶尖速比外推能力限制；结果提供了兼顾系统功率与推力的配置选择依据，并表明L/D=0.20的高功率配置具有最低峰值推力。摘要未提供实验验证及额定风速以上适用性的结果。

title: Zernike-efficient phase contrast with a scanned electron probe
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 1 table; supplementary material (12 pages) . Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24170512
summary: For weak-phase objects, scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) with a far-field detector transfers at most half of the phase information per electron that Zernike phase-contrast (ZPC) conventional transmission electron microscopy (CTEM) achieves. We propose APEX (Apex Phase-plate EXit-wave imaging), a scanned-probe mode that combines a defocused probe, a $π/2$ phase element in a magnified image of the probe crossover, and in-focus image-plane detection at each scan position. It applies the generalized Zernike framework of Dwyer and Paganin to a scanned probe. In a linear model of a thin weak-phase object with an ideal phase dot, APEX transfers nearly the full Zernike Fisher information over a wide band, substantially more than diffraction-plane four-dimensional STEM (4D-STEM). In idealized simulations of myoglobin in vitreous ice at a cryo-EM dose (elastic scattering only, no chromatic aberration, full coherence), ideal-dot APEX at a probe defocus of 1 $μ$m reconstructs the phase more accurately than defocused 4D-STEM ptychography with one untuned probe setting. At a defocus of about 25 $μ$m, a crossed laser phase plate (XLPP) acts as the $π/2$ element, and APEX of a periodic specimen cell comes close to CTEM with the same plate. In two dimensions, this mode is equivalent to laser phase-plate CTEM of a small, scanned area. A single simulated APEX scan with the XLPP also separates two myoglobin phase screens 150 nm apart in vacuum, at known depths, which is not possible with one ZPC CTEM exposure.

AI.tldr: 论文提出扫描探针模式 APEX，通过离焦探针、探针交叉点放大像中的 π/2 相位元件和每个扫描位置的像面聚焦探测，提高弱相位物体的相位信息传递效率。
AI.motivation: 弱相位物体在远场探测器 STEM 中每个电子最多只能传递 Zernike 相位衬度 CTEM 所实现相位信息的一半，因此需要一种能接近完整 Zernike Fisher 信息传递的扫描成像模式。
AI.method: APEX 将 Dwyer 和 Paganin 的广义 Zernike 框架应用于扫描探针，组合离焦探针、位于探针交叉点放大像中的 π/2 相位元件，以及每个扫描位置的像面聚焦探测；分析采用薄弱相位物体和理想相位点的线性模型，并进行肌红蛋白玻璃态冰模拟及周期性样品池模拟，其中约 25 μm 离焦时交叉激光相位板（XLPP）作为 π/2 元件。
AI.result: 理想相位点 APEX 在宽频带内传递接近完整的 Zernike Fisher 信息，显著多于衍射面 4D-STEM；在冷冻电镜剂量、仅弹性散射、无色差和完全相干条件下，1 μm 探针离焦的理想点 APEX 比单一未调谐探针设置的离焦 4D-STEM 叠层成像更准确地重建相位；约 25 μm 离焦下 XLPP 作为 π/2 元件时，周期性样品池的 APEX 接近使用同一相位板的 CTEM；二维中该模式等价于小扫描区域的激光相位板 CTEM；单次模拟 XLPP-APEX 扫描还可在真空中按已知深度分离相距 150 nm 的两个肌红蛋白相位屏，而单次 ZPC CTEM 曝光无法做到。
AI.conclusion: APEX 能显著提升弱相位物体的相位信息传递和重建精度，并具备单次扫描深度分离能力；摘要未提供实验验证或更广泛样品条件下的结论。

title: An Efficient Method for Directly Integrating the Vlasov Equation in Collisionless and Weakly-Collisional Simulations
comment: 31 pages, 20 figures, submitted to the Open Journal of Astrophysics. Comments welcome. Implementation in the public GIZMO code available at http://www.tapir.caltech.edu/~phopkins/Site/GIZMO.html
summary: We describe and test a new numerical method to solve the Vlasov/Boltzmann equation in systems with arbitrary levels of collisionality. The method combines recent ideas to evolve the distribution function (DF) directly in 6+1 dimensional phase-space in a manner which is Lagrangian in both position+velocity. The 'particles' of traditional Monte-Carlo/Particle-In-Cell/N-body (MC/PIC/NB) methods become mesh-generating points defining a volume partition, each of which carries a set of momentum-Lagrangian basis functions representing a local anisotropic momentum DF. The DF is then integrated between cells and bases via a higher-order reconstruction and Godunov-type method, evolving a 10 or 13-moment representation of each basis to ensure manifest mass/momentum/energy conservation. The method allows one to represent arbitrary DFs, including multiple independent streams but also collisional or phase-mixed or thermal distributions (unlike traditional 'moments' or waterbag/tessellation methods), and the cost is bounded to a modest multiplier of MC/PIC/NB costs. We provide an example implementation which uses a spatially-Lagrangian volume partition, second-order reconstruction, and simple set of bases which ensure constant cell masses and couple directly to existing MC/PIC/NB machinery, made public in the code GIZMO. We validate in a series of test problems, demonstrating manifest conservation, Galilean and translation and rotation invariance, and ability to represent complex DFs without spurious dissipation or instability. We discuss applications where this method can have advantages compared to traditional algorithms for simulations of dark matter, stellar, weakly-collisional neutral gas, and particulate/dust dynamics; multiphase/polydisperse flows; cosmic ray and radiation transport/hydrodynamics; and plasma physics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证一种用于任意碰撞性系统中 Vlasov/Boltzmann 方程的新数值方法：在 6+1 维相空间中以位置和速度均拉格朗日的方式直接演化分布函数，并将传统 MC/PIC/NB 的粒子作为网格生成点，每个点携带动量拉格朗日基函数以表示局部各向异性动量分布；通过高阶重构和 Godunov 型方法在单元与基之间积分，并用 10 或 13 矩表示保证质量、动量和能量显式守恒。示例实现在 GIZMO 中，测试显示守恒性、伽利略/平移/旋转不变性及复杂分布函数表示能力，成本为 MC/PIC/NB 的适度倍数。
AI.motivation: 动机是求解任意碰撞性条件下的 Vlasov/Boltzmann 方程，并克服传统蒙特卡洛/粒子网格/N 体方法以及传统矩方法、水袋/镶嵌方法在表示任意分布函数方面的限制；目标包括同时表示多流、碰撞、相混合和热分布，同时将计算成本控制在传统 MC/PIC/NB 成本的适度倍数内。
AI.method: 方法在 6+1 维相空间中直接演化分布函数，位置和速度均采用拉格朗日描述。传统 MC/PIC/NB 的“粒子”成为定义体积划分的网格生成点，每个点携带一组动量拉格朗日基函数，表示局部各向异性动量分布函数；分布函数通过高阶重构和 Godunov 型方法在单元与基之间积分，并对每个基演化 10 或 13 矩表示，以保证质量、动量和能量的显式守恒。示例实现采用空间拉格朗日体积划分、二阶重构和一组确保单元质量恒定的简单基函数，可直接耦合现有 MC/PIC/NB 机制，并已在 GIZMO 代码中公开。
AI.result: 在一系列测试问题中验证了该方法：显示显式守恒、伽利略不变性、平移不变性和旋转不变性，并能表示复杂分布函数而不会产生虚假耗散或不稳定性；成本被限制在 MC/PIC/NB 成本的适度倍数。摘要未提供具体定量精度、收敛阶或性能数据。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可表示任意分布函数，包括多个独立流以及碰撞、相混合或热分布，并可直接接入现有 MC/PIC/NB 框架。作者认为该方法相对于传统算法可应用于暗物质、恒星、弱碰撞中性气体、颗粒/尘埃动力学、多相/多分散流、宇宙线与辐射输运/流体力学以及等离子体物理等模拟场景。

title: Quantum Sensor of Mechanical Vibrations
summary: We report the use of a single trapped-ion motional mode as a probe of mechanical vibrations of the Paul trap structure. By exciting vibrations of the trap using an ultrasonic transducer mounted outside the vacuum chamber and probing the ion motion through motional sideband interactions, we observe a clear resonance response of the axial mode. We further demonstrate detection of trap vibrations with amplitudes as low as 0.6 picometers. These measurements show direct coupling between macroscopic mechanical motion and trapped-ion dynamics, providing a route toward vibration sensing using quantum control of motional states.

AI.tldr: 本文利用单个囚禁离子的运动模式探测保罗阱结构的机械振动：通过真空腔外的超声换能器激发阱振动，并用运动边带相互作用读取离子运动，观察到轴向模式的共振响应，且检测到低至0.6皮米的振动幅度。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确给出研究背景与动机；从论文表述看，其目标在于建立宏观机械运动与囚禁离子动力学之间的直接耦合，并为利用运动态量子控制实现振动传感提供途径。
AI.method: 采用单个囚禁离子的运动模式作为机械振动探针；使用安装在真空腔外的超声换能器激发阱结构振动；通过运动边带相互作用探测离子运动，并观测轴向模式的共振响应。
AI.result: 实验观察到清晰的轴向模式共振响应，并演示了对低至0.6皮米振幅的阱振动检测；测量显示宏观机械运动与囚禁离子动力学之间存在直接耦合。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明可利用囚禁离子运动模式探测阱结构振动，并为基于运动态量子控制的振动传感提供了技术路线。

title: Multicomponent Adaptive Sampling Configuration Interaction method in openLOWDIN: positronic and quantum nuclear systems
summary: We present a multicomponent Selective Configuration Interaction (SCI) method based on the deterministic Adaptive Sampling CI (ASCI) algorithm for computing energies and wavefunction properties of molecular systems containing leptons of variable masses, or quantum nuclei. Near-FCI accuracy is achieved by incorporating second-order Epstein-Nesbet perturbation theory or by dressing the Hamiltonian via Davidson's and co-workers shifted-Bk method. We validate the approach through benchmark positronic (e$^+$LiH, e$^+$OH$^-$, e$^+$Mg) and quantum nuclear systems (HCN), establishing a novel protocol for accurate convergence, based on the iterative adaptation of natural orbitals starting from those obtained by considering only cross-particle CISD excitations, to those obtained from SCI variational space, surpassing the accuracy of previous SCI studies. Overall, we show that the present multi-component SCI framework offers a simple, systematically improvable, and cost-effective alternative to traditional CI approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于确定性自适应采样CI（ASCI）的多组分选择性CI（SCI）方法，用于含可变质量轻子或量子核的分子体系，并通过微扰校正和自然轨道迭代实现近FCI精度。
AI.motivation: 为含可变质量轻子或量子核的分子体系提供近FCI精度、系统可改进且成本有效的能量与波函数性质计算方案，作为传统CI方法的替代；摘要未量化传统CI的具体计算瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用确定性ASCI构建多组分SCI；利用二阶Epstein-Nesbet微扰理论或Davidson等提出的shifted-Bk方法修饰哈密顿量；采用自然轨道迭代自适应协议，从仅考虑跨粒子CISD激发所得自然轨道出发，迭代至SCI变分空间所得自然轨道。
AI.result: 在正电子体系e+LiH、e+OH-、e+Mg及量子核体系HCN上验证，获得近FCI精度；该收敛协议优于此前SCI研究；摘要未提供具体能量误差或计算成本数值。
AI.conclusion: 该多组分SCI框架简单、可系统改进且成本有效，可作为传统CI方法的替代方案。

title: Experimental Evidence of Elastic Instability in Viscoelastic Kolmogorov Flow
summary: Inertialess elastic instabilities can profoundly affect transport in complex-fluid flows, from mixing in microfluidic devices and displacement through porous media to polymer processing. While such instabilities are well understood in flows with curved streamlines, their origin in rectilinear flows like the prototypical Kolmogorov flow remains unresolved. Here, we report the first experimental evidence of the center-mode elastic instability, at vanishing inertia, in a confined quasi-two-dimensional viscoelastic Kolmogorov flow, driven by electromagnetic forcing. The instability is characterized by the emergence of "arrow-shaped" structures in the velocity field, which fluctuates chaotically as the forcing strength increases. We reproduce these observations in simulations of the Oldroyd-B model and trace the dynamics in the confined flow to the travelling arrowhead structures that emerge from the center-mode instability of unbounded Kolmogorov flow. Our work establishes a generic route to purely elastic instability in rectilinear flows, broadening the conditions under which elastic turbulence and enhanced mixing can arise.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在无惯性、受限准二维黏弹性Kolmogorov流中实验观测到中心模态弹性不稳定性，并用Oldroyd-B模拟重现了“箭头状”速度结构与混沌涨落，将其归因于无界Kolmogorov流中心模态不稳定性产生的行进行箭头结构。
AI.motivation: 弹性不稳定性会显著影响微流控混合、多孔介质驱替和聚合物加工等复杂流体输运；其在弯曲流线流动中已较清楚，但在Kolmogorov流这类直线流动中的起源仍未解决。
AI.method: 在无惯性条件下，用电磁驱动力驱动受限准二维黏弹性Kolmogorov流开展实验，表征速度场中的箭头状结构及随驱动力增强的混沌涨落；并用Oldroyd-B模型进行数值模拟，将受限流动中的动力学追溯到无界Kolmogorov流中心模态不稳定性产生的行进行箭头结构。
AI.result: 实验首次观测到中心模态弹性不稳定性，表现为速度场出现“箭头状”结构，且随驱动力增强而混沌涨落；Oldroyd-B模拟重现了这些观察，并表明受限流动中的动力学源于无界Kolmogorov流的行进行箭头结构。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了直线流动中纯弹性不稳定性的通用途径，拓宽了弹性湍流和强化混合可能出现的条件。

title: Intraband vs. interband optical nonlinearities of transparent conducting oxides
summary: We show that the intraband thermo-optical response to ultrashort intense infra-red illumination of transparent conducting oxides is much stronger than the nonlinear response associated with resonant and non-resonant interband transitions in typical experimental setups. This finding rules out several speculative explanations of recent measurements.

AI.tldr: 该文指出，在典型实验条件下，透明导电氧化物受超短强红外照射时，带内热光响应显著强于共振与非共振带间跃迁引起的非线性响应，从而排除了对近期测量的一些推测性解释。
AI.motivation: 解释近期相关测量结果，并辨别透明导电氧化物在超短强红外激发下的主导响应机制；摘要未提供更具体的动机细节。
AI.method: 摘要未说明具体理论或实验方法，仅表明通过比较带内热光响应与共振、非共振带间跃迁非线性响应在典型实验装置中的相对强弱来开展分析。
AI.result: 透明导电氧化物的带内热光响应对超短强红外照射远强于典型实验装置中与共振和非共振带间跃迁相关的非线性响应。
AI.conclusion: 带内热光响应是所述条件下的主导机制，该发现排除了若干针对近期测量的推测性解释；摘要未提供定量结果或具体应用结论。

title: Magnetic Flux Eruptions in Magnetically Arrested Disks: Magnetic Reconnection and Bubble Expansion
comment: Accepted for publication in ApJ; 14 pages, 10 figures
summary: Using a high-resolution GRMHD simulation of a magnetically arrested disk, we investigate the physical mechanism driving magnetic-flux eruption. The horizon-threading magnetic flux declines mainly in off-equatorial regions, whereas localized hot spots associated with magnetic reconnection appear near the equatorial plane around the onset of flux decline. A non-axisymmetric, magnetically supported low-density structure, which we identify as a magnetic bubble, expands radially and azimuthally within a pre-existing low-density channel in the filamentary accretion flow. Based on these findings, we propose a physical picture linking reconnection, bubble expansion, and horizon magnetic flux decline. The reconnection occurs in the pre-existing low-density channel, and may reconfigure the field and promote bubble expansion. Magnetic-pressure gradients provide broadly distributed outward support for the expansion, while magnetic tension contributes a localized outward force near the equator. Bubble expansion may limit gas replenishment, helping to maintain the low-density region and reduce the total pressure near the equator. This pressure reduction may facilitate equatorward electromagnetic energy transport. In the simulation, the polar electromagnetic energy flux reverses from poleward to equatorward near the onset of the horizon-flux decline. The equatorward transport is concentrated in the bubble sector and carries electromagnetic energy from the off-equatorial magnetosphere to the equatorial region. This energy supply may sustain localized reconnection and plasma heating as the eruption develops.

AI.tldr: 该文利用高分辨率GRMHD模拟磁 arrested 盘，提出磁重联、磁泡膨胀与视界磁通下降相联系的物理图像。
AI.motivation: 研究磁 arrested 盘中磁通爆发（magnetic-flux eruption）的物理驱动机制，即理解视界穿 threading 磁通为何及如何下降。摘要未进一步说明更广泛的研究背景或应用动机。
AI.method: 采用高分辨率广义相对论磁流体力学（GRMHD）模拟磁 arrested 盘，分析视界磁通下降、赤道面附近重联热斑、低密度通道中的非轴对称磁泡结构以及电磁能流方向变化。
AI.result: 视界穿 threading 磁通主要在非赤道区域下降；磁通下降开始前后，赤道面附近出现与磁重联相关的局域热斑。一个非轴对称、磁压支撑的低密度“磁泡”在丝状吸积流中原有低密度通道内沿径向和方位向膨胀。磁压梯度提供较广泛的向外支撑，磁张力在赤道附近提供局域向外力。磁泡膨胀可能限制气体补充，维持低密度区并降低赤道附近总压，从而促进电磁能向赤道输运；模拟中极向电磁能流在视界磁通下降开始时由向极转为向赤道，且该输运集中于磁泡扇区，将电磁能从非赤道磁层带到赤道区域。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出一个将磁重联、磁泡膨胀和视界磁通下降联系起来的物理图景：重联发生在原有低密度通道中，可能重构磁场并促进磁泡膨胀；磁泡膨胀维持低密度区并降低赤道附近总压，促进向赤道的电磁能输运，而该能量供给可能维持局域重联和等离子体加热，伴随爆发发展。

title: Collective coupling of over 100 individually trapped atoms to a single cavity mode
summary: Coupling optical tweezer arrays to high-finesse cavities provides a shared optical interface for neutral-atom registers. Scaling this interface to large tweezer arrays requires placing many traps within the coupling region of a single cavity mode while maintaining uniform trapping and site-resolved detection. Here we match a two-dimensional array of 192 optical tweezers to the coupling profile of a millimeter-scale Fabry-Perot cavity. To improve trap uniformity in the array generated by crossed acousto-optic deflectors, we combine optimization with optical feedback and atomic fluorescence feedback, achieving a mean cesium loading probability of approximately 58%. In each trial, fluorescence imaging determines whether each individual tweezer site is occupied, allowing the cavity transmission spectra to be grouped by atom number. The grouped spectra exhibit resolved normal-mode doublets, and the group with 120 imaged atoms yields an effective collective coupling of $G_{\mathrm{eff}}/(2π) = 21.30 \pm 0.23$ MHz. A model based on the calculated coupling profile and measured site loading probabilities predicts that the mean squared coupling per occupied site changes little between 97 and 120 atoms. The fitted collective coupling is therefore consistent with square-root scaling with atom number despite the spatial variation in single-atom coupling. These results provide an experimental basis for studying photon-mediated many-body dynamics and developing cavity-assisted readout and optical links between neutral-atom registers.

AI.tldr: 作者将包含192个光镊的二维阵列与毫米尺度法布里-珀罗腔的耦合分布进行匹配，利用荧光成像按原子数对腔透射谱分组，观测到简正模双峰，并测得120个原子时有效集体耦合为 G_eff/(2π)=21.30±0.23 MHz。
AI.motivation: 将光镊阵列耦合到高精细度腔可为中性原子寄存器提供共享光学接口；但要把该接口扩展到大型光镊阵列，需要在单一腔模的耦合区域内放置大量光镊，同时保持均匀囚禁和位点分辨检测。
AI.method: 将192个光镊构成的二维阵列匹配到毫米尺度法布里-珀罗腔的耦合分布；针对交叉声光偏转器产生的阵列，结合优化、光学反馈和原子荧光反馈提升陷阱均匀性，使铯的平均装载概率约为58%；每次试验用荧光成像判定各光镊位点是否被占据，并按原子数对腔透射谱分组。
AI.result: 分组后的腔透射谱显示出可分辨的简正模双峰；包含120个成像原子的组给出有效集体耦合 G_eff/(2π)=21.30±0.23 MHz。基于计算耦合分布和实测位点装载概率的模型预测，在97至120个原子之间，每个占据位点的均方耦合变化很小；尽管单原子耦合存在空间差异，拟合的集体耦合仍与随原子数的平方根标度一致。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为研究光子介导的多体动力学，以及发展腔辅助读出和中性原子寄存器间的光学连接提供了实验基础。

title: Full-horizon magnetic control of the Vlasov--Poisson system for plasma confinement
summary: We study the full-horizon control of a two-dimensional Vlasov--Poisson system through an externally imposed magnetic field. The control is represented by time-dependent coefficients associated with smooth, spatially localized basis functions, and is designed to steer selected position and velocity moments of the distribution function while limiting particle dispersion and the control effort. Starting from the kinetic constrained optimization problem, we derive the continuous first-order optimality conditions, including a backward Vlasov equation, an elliptic adjoint equation, and the variational inequality associated with bounded controls. We then project this system onto a particle--grid representation and identify the resulting particle adjoints and control gradient.
