The full-horizon field is then computed on a reduced particle ensemble, initialized by an instantaneous control, and subsequently applied to a larger set of particles. Numerical experiments indicate that the instantaneous control field already provides an effective baseline, while the full-horizon correction can further reduce the relative thermal energy near the boundaries and improve confinement over the prescribed time interval.

AI.tldr: 本文研究通过外加磁场对二维 Vlasov--Poisson 系统进行全时域控制：以平滑空间局部基函数的时间相关系数为控制量，在限制粒子弥散和控制代价的同时调控分布函数的位置与速度矩，并给出连续最优性条件、粒子--网格离散及数值验证。
AI.motivation: 动机是设计外加磁场控制，使二维 Vlasov--Poisson 系统中选定的位置和速度矩达到目标，同时限制粒子弥散与控制努力，并改善指定时间区间内的约束性能。
AI.method: 控制由与平滑、空间局部基函数相关的时间依赖系数表示。作者从动理学约束优化问题出发，推导连续一阶最优性条件，包括后向 Vlasov 方程、椭圆伴随方程以及有界控制对应的变分不等式；随后投影到粒子--网格表示，识别粒子伴随变量与控制梯度；全时域场先在由瞬时控制初始化的缩减粒子系综上计算，再应用于更大粒子集合。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，瞬时控制场已能提供有效基线；全时域修正可进一步降低边界附近的相对热能量，并在规定时间区间内改善约束。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于连续最优性条件与粒子--网格离散的全时域磁控制框架具有可行性；瞬时控制可作为有效基线，全时域修正在改善边界热能量与约束方面带来额外收益。摘要未提供定量性能指标、误差或收敛性结论。

title: Reconstruction and Forecast of Extreme Waves from a Single Observation
summary: The state space of a dynamical system can, under suitable conditions, be reconstructed from a single observational time-series through delay-coordinate embedding. However, reconstructing the spatiotemporal evolution of nonlinear water waves from highly sparse measurements remains a considerable challenge. Here, by combining deep learning, compressed sensing, and the self-similarity properties of unidirectional nonlinear water wave evolution equation, we show that the evolving surface elevation of a highly nonlinear wave field can be reconstructed from observations collected at a {\it single} measurement location. We subsequently use these reconstructions to forecast rogue waves associated with self-focusing soliton dynamics from point observations obtained in controlled water wave tank experiments, demonstrating excellent agreement with measurements of the fully evolved wave field. Our results show that extreme wave events can be forecast from remarkably sparse observations and provide a framework that may be extended to other nonlinear dispersive systems governed by the interplay of dispersion and nonlinearity.

AI.tldr: 该文提出融合深度学习、压缩感知与单向非线性水波演化方程自相似性的方法，仅利用单个测点的观测即可重建高度非线性波场的演化表面高程，并在水波槽实验中预报由自聚焦孤子动力学产生的极端波。
AI.motivation: 从高度稀疏的测量中重建非线性水波的时空演化仍很困难；现有状态空间重构方法虽可利用延迟坐标嵌入从单一时间序列重构动力系统，但将其用于非线性水波场仍具挑战。
AI.method: 结合深度学习、压缩感知以及单向非线性水波演化方程的自相似性，从单个测量位置收集的观测中重建高度非线性波场的演化表面高程，并据此从受控水波槽实验的点观测中预报与自聚焦孤子动力学相关的极端波。
AI.result: 重建结果被用于预报极端波，预报与完全演化波场的实验测量高度一致，表明极端波事件可从非常稀疏的观测中预报；摘要未给出具体定量误差指标。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明极端波事件能够基于稀疏观测进行预报，并提供了一个可推广至其他由色散与非线性相互作用支配的非线性色散系统的框架。

title: Microwave hinge states in an all-dielectric woodpile photonic crystal insulator
summary: Higher-order topological states are studied in a woodpile photonic crystal (PhC) having a large complete photonic bandgap. According to theoretical predictions, we fabricate a three-dimensional all-dielectric PhC with a millimeter-scale lattice period. The structure consists of two distinct lattice types that coincide through a structural displacement, where their interface intersection gives rise to hinge states. Microwave transmission measurements reveal transmission peaks and spatial localization at the intersection, demonstrating the hinge states. Furthermore, we confirm the absence of hinge states at a specific intersection. As theoretically predicted, hinge states emerge at intersections where the localized boundary polarizations are topologically different, whereas they are absent at intersections where the boundary polarizations are equivalent.

AI.tldr: 本文在具有大完全光子带隙的woodpile光子晶体中研究高阶拓扑态，制备了毫米级晶格周期的三维全介质结构，并通过微波透射测量观测到界面交叠处的铰链态及其空间局域化，同时验证了特定交叠处铰链态的缺失。
AI.motivation: 研究具有大完全光子带隙的woodpile光子晶体中的高阶拓扑态，并依据理论预测开展三维全介质光子晶体的实验实现与验证。
AI.method: 制备具有毫米级晶格周期的三维全介质woodpile光子晶体；结构中两类不同晶格通过结构位移重合，其界面交叠产生铰链态；采用微波透射测量检测透射峰与空间局域化，并检查特定交叠处是否存在铰链态。
AI.result: 微波透射测量显示界面交叠处存在透射峰和空间局域化，证明铰链态的存在；同时确认在某一特定交叠处不存在铰链态。实验结果与理论预测一致：当交叠处两侧局域边界极化在拓扑上不同时出现铰链态，而当边界极化等价时铰链态缺失。
AI.conclusion: 该研究实验展示了三维全介质woodpile光子晶体中的高阶拓扑铰链态，并验证了铰链态的出现与缺失取决于交叠处局域边界极化是否具有拓扑差异。

title: Micro-Macro Tensor Neural Surrogates for Uncertainty Quantification in Collisional Plasma
summary: Plasma kinetic equations exhibit pronounced sensitivity to microscopic perturbations in model parameters and data, making reliable and efficient uncertainty quantification (UQ) essential for predictive simulations. However, the cost of uncertainty sampling, the high-dimensional phase space, and multiscale stiffness pose severe challenges to both computational efficiency and error control in traditional numerical methods. These aspects are further emphasized in presence of collisions where the high-dimensional nonlocal collision integrations and conservation properties pose severe constraints. To overcome this, we present a variance-reduced Monte Carlo framework for UQ in the Vlasov--Poisson--Landau (VPL) system, in which neural network surrogates replace the multiple costly evaluations of the Landau collision term. The method couples a high-fidelity, asymptotic-preserving VPL solver with inexpensive, strongly correlated surrogates based on the Vlasov--Poisson--Fokker--Planck (VPFP) and Euler--Poisson (EP) equations. For the surrogate models, we introduce a generalization of the separable physics-informed neural network (SPINN), developing a class of tensor neural networks based on an anisotropic micro-macro decomposition, to reduce velocity-moment costs, model complexity, and the curse of dimensionality. To further increase correlation with VPL, we calibrate the VPFP model and design an asymptotic-preserving SPINN whose small- and large-Knudsen limits recover the EP and VP systems, respectively. Numerical experiments show substantial variance reduction over standard Monte Carlo, accurate statistics with far fewer high-fidelity samples, and lower wall-clock time, while maintaining robustness to stochastic dimension.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向Vlasov–Poisson–Landau系统不确定性量化的方差缩减蒙特卡洛框架，利用神经网络代理替代昂贵的Landau碰撞项多次评估，从而以更少高保真样本获得准确统计并降低计算耗时。
AI.motivation: 等离子体动理学方程对模型参数和数据的微观扰动高度敏感，可靠高效的不确定性量化对预测模拟至关重要；但不确定性采样成本、高维相空间和多尺度刚性给传统数值方法的计算效率与误差控制带来严重挑战，碰撞情形下高维非局部碰撞积分及守恒性质进一步加剧困难。
AI.method: 将高保真渐近保持VPL求解器与基于VPFP和Euler–Poisson方程的廉价且强相关代理模型耦合；推广可分离物理信息神经网络SPINN，基于各向异性微宏观分解构建张量神经网络，以降低速度矩成本、模型复杂度和维数灾难；校准VPFP模型并设计渐近保持SPINN，使其在小Knudsen和大Knudsen极限下分别恢复EP和VP系统。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该方法相对标准蒙特卡洛实现显著方差缩减，以远更少的高保真样本获得准确统计，墙钟时间更低，并对随机维度保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过强相关代理模型和方差缩减蒙特卡洛提升VPL系统不确定性量化的效率，减少高保真VPL评估需求，同时保持统计精度和随机维度鲁棒性。

title: Absence of binding for the helium anion
summary: We study the helium anion in the nonrelativistic Coulomb model with an infinitely massive nucleus and spin-$\frac12$ electrons. We prove the absence of binding, with $E^{\mathrm{F}}(3,2)=E^{\mathrm{F}}(2,2)$ and no three-electron ground state. A decomposition relative to the helium ground state and completion of the square reduce the problem to a one-dimensional variational inequality.

AI.tldr: 该文在非相对论库仑模型中研究氦负离子，证明三电子体系相对于两电子氦体系不发生束缚，二者基态能量相等，且不存在三电子基态；证明归结为一维变分不等式。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确展开研究动机，只说明要研究无限大质量原子核与自旋1/2电子构成的非相对论库仑模型中的氦负离子，并判定三电子体系是否存在束缚和基态。
AI.method: 采用非相对论库仑模型，假设原子核质量无限大、电子自旋为1/2；相对于氦基态作分解，并通过配方将问题约化为一维变分不等式。
AI.result: 证明氦负离子不束缚，得到 E^F(3,2)=E^F(2,2)，并证明不存在三电子基态。
AI.conclusion: 在该模型框架内，三电子氦体系没有稳定束缚态，其基态能量与两电子氦体系相同；摘要未提供更多关于推广或物理含义的结论。

title: Control strategies for magnetized plasma: a polar coordinates framework
summary: In this work, we provide an overview of various control strategies aimed at steering plasma toward desired configurations using an external magnetic field. From a modeling perspective, we focus on the Vlasov equation in a two-dimensional bounded domain, accounting for both a self-induced electric field and a strong external magnetic field. The results are presented in a polar coordinate framework, which is particularly well-suited for simulating toroidal devices such as Tokamaks and Stellarators. A key feature of the proposed control strategies is their feedback mechanism, which is based on an instantaneous prediction of the discretized system. Finally, different numerical experiments in the two-dimensional polar coordinate setting demonstrate the effectiveness of the approaches.

AI.tldr: 该文综述并研究了利用外部磁场将等离子体引导至期望位形的控制策略；建模采用二维有界区域中的 Vlasov 方程，包含自感电场与强外部磁场，并在适合 Tokamaks、Stellarators 等环形装置的极坐标框架下，通过基于离散系统瞬时预测的反馈机制进行控制，数值实验验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 旨在利用外部磁场对等离子体进行控制，使其趋向期望位形；极坐标框架特别适合模拟 Tokamaks 和 Stellarators 等环形装置。摘要未提供更具体的应用需求或性能目标。
AI.method: 综述多种控制策略；从建模角度采用二维有界区域中的 Vlasov 方程，同时考虑自感电场和强外部磁场；结果在极坐标框架中表述；控制策略的关键特征是反馈机制，该机制基于离散系统的瞬时预测；并开展二维极坐标数值实验。
AI.result: 不同二维极坐标数值实验表明所提方法有效。摘要未给出定量误差、对比基线、计算成本或理论保证等具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的反馈控制策略在二维极坐标数值实验中显示出有效性，适用于 Tokamaks 和 Stellarators 等环形装置的建模范式；摘要未给出稳定性、最优性或实际装置验证方面的结论。

title: Will it bend? Modelling hydrogel box hinges with a gel Lattice Spring Method
summary: Hydrogels are biocompatible smart materials comprised of a hydrophilic polymer network which can absorb a large volume of water (swelling). The changes in shape the gel undergoes as it swells or de-swells can be utilised in the design of actuators. This is of particular interest for many applications whereby hydrogel actuators would be combined into a complex origami-inspired structure which can fold and unfold according to application needs. In this paper, we therefore focus on one such actuator design, the bilayer hinge, which can induce bending (for potential use in a fold/unfold mechanism). We develop a model using the gel lattice spring method (gLSM) which can be used to simulate composite structures comprised of hydrogel and elastomer and compute the equilibrium bending angle of bilayer hinges for a range of geometries and material properties.

AI.tldr: 本文关注用于折叠/展开机构的双层铰链式水凝胶驱动器，采用凝胶晶格弹簧方法（gLSM）建立可模拟水凝胶-弹性体复合结构的模型，并计算不同几何与材料参数下的平衡弯曲角。摘要未给出定量结果或实验验证。
AI.motivation: 水凝胶可随溶胀/去溶胀发生形状变化，适合设计驱动器；将其集成到受折纸启发的复杂结构中，需要能够按需折叠和展开的驱动器，因此作者研究可诱导弯曲的双层铰链。
AI.method: 采用凝胶晶格弹簧方法（gLSM）建立模型，用于模拟由水凝胶和弹性体组成的复合结构，并计算双层铰链在一系列几何条件和材料属性下的平衡弯曲角。
AI.result: 摘要仅说明所建gLSM模型能够模拟水凝胶-弹性体复合结构并计算双层铰链的平衡弯曲角；未提供具体数值结果、实验验证或性能比较。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为面向折纸启发应用的双层铰链水凝胶驱动器提供了几何与材料参数影响的分析工具；摘要未报告实验验证或实际应用结果。

title: Active Contrast-Dissipation All-Optical Encryption
summary: Optical encryption is meant to place secrecy in physical structure, yet adversaries can readily construct imperfect physical keys to probe the encryption system via trial-and-error iterations. Such systems inevitably leak target plaintext information and preserve invertible residual structural features, rendering the entire encryption scheme vulnerable to adversarial inversion attacks. Here, we report an active contrast-dissipation all-optical encryption architecture, which partitions wavefront modulation into M wavelength-private encryption layers and N shared decoding layers. Security rests on multi-dimensional physical keys that must match simultaneously, including illumination wavelength, precise spatial alignment and layer stacking sequence. With every key matched and authorized readout is preserved: the composite plaintext is reconstructed at a full-detector Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) of 0.997. We further impose active contrast dissipation as a core security constraint. Under physical perturbation it suppresses the foreground-background intensity contrast, so that the slightest key mismatch collapses the target features and dissipates the plaintext into randomized, diffuse speckle within chaotic background noise, leaving no residual semantic leakage to invert. Under nanoscale wavelength detuning, a 1 degree in-plane rotation, a single-pixel lateral displacement or layer-stacking tampering, the plaintext vanishes and the PCC approaches zero, whereas conventional diffractive encryptors retain identifiable contours. This work provide a feasible and reliable solution for high-security information encryption, with great application potential in communication security, information anti-counterfeiting, and confidential data storage.

AI.tldr: 提出一种主动对比度耗散的全光加密架构，将波前调制划分为M个波长私有加密层和N个共享解码层，安全性依赖波长、精确空间对准和层堆叠顺序等多维物理密钥的同时匹配；授权匹配时以PCC 0.997重建复合明文，密钥失配时明文耗散为随机漫散斑并趋近零PCC。
AI.motivation: 光学加密虽将保密性置于物理结构中，但对手可利用不完美物理密钥进行试错探测，系统会泄漏目标明文信息并保留可逆的残余结构特征，从而易受对抗反演攻击，因此需要更高安全性的加密方案。
AI.method: 将波前调制分区为M个波长私有加密层和N个共享解码层；安全机制要求照明波长、精确空间对准和层堆叠顺序等多维物理密钥同时匹配。以主动对比度耗散为核心安全约束，在物理扰动下抑制前景与背景的强度对比，使轻微密钥失配导致目标特征崩塌，并将明文耗散为随机、弥散的散斑并融入混沌背景噪声。
AI.result: 所有密钥匹配并授权读取时，复合明文重建的全探测器Pearson相关系数为0.997。在纳米级波长失谐、1度面内旋转、单像素横向位移或层堆叠篡改下，明文消失且PCC趋近零，而传统衍射加密器仍保留可识别轮廓。摘要未提供M和N的具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为高安全性信息加密提供可行且可靠的方案，在通信安全、信息防伪和机密数据存储方面具有应用潜力。

title: Structure and asymptotic preserving deep neural surrogates for uncertainty quantification in multiscale kinetic equations
summary: The high dimensionality of kinetic equations with stochastic parameters poses major computational challenges for uncertainty quantification (UQ). Traditional Monte Carlo (MC) sampling methods, while widely used, suffer from slow convergence and high variance, which become increasingly severe as the dimensionality of the parameter space grows. To accelerate MC sampling, we adopt a multiscale control variates strategy that leverages low-fidelity solutions from simplified kinetic models to reduce variance. To further improve sampling efficiency and preserve the underlying physics, we introduce surrogate models based on structure and asymptotic preserving neural networks (SAPNNs). These deep neural networks are specifically designed to satisfy key physical properties, including positivity, conservation laws, entropy dissipation, and asymptotic limits. By training the SAPNNs on low-fidelity models and enriching them with selected high-fidelity samples from the full Boltzmann equation, our method achieves significant variance reduction while maintaining physical consistency and asymptotic accuracy. The proposed methodology enables efficient large-scale prediction in kinetic UQ and is validated across both homogeneous and nonhomogeneous multiscale regimes. Numerical results demonstrate improved accuracy and computational efficiency compared to standard MC techniques.

AI.tldr: 针对含随机参数的高维动理学方程不确定性量化，提出结合多尺度控制变量与结构/渐近保持神经网络代理模型的方法，以降低蒙特卡洛采样方差并保持物理一致性，在均匀与非均匀多尺度情形下验证了相较标准蒙特卡洛的精度与效率提升。
AI.motivation: 高维含随机参数的动理学方程给不确定性量化带来显著计算挑战；传统蒙特卡洛采样收敛慢、方差大，且随参数空间维度增加问题更严重。
AI.method: 采用多尺度控制变量策略，利用简化动理学模型的低保真解降低方差；引入基于结构与渐近保持神经网络（SAPNNs）的代理模型，使其满足正性、守恒律、熵耗散和渐近极限等关键物理性质；用低保真模型训练SAPNNs，并加入从完整Boltzmann方程选取的高保真样本进行增强。
AI.result: 方法实现显著方差降低并保持物理一致性与渐近精度；在均匀和非均匀多尺度情形下验证，数值结果较标准蒙特卡洛技术表现出更高的精度和计算效率；摘要未提供具体定量指标。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法可用于动理学不确定性量化中的高效大规模预测，并在保持物理一致性和渐近准确性的同时改善相对标准蒙特卡洛的精度与计算效率。

title: Robust feedback control of collisional plasma dynamics in presence of uncertainties
summary: Magnetic fusion aims to confine high-temperature plasma within a device, enabling the fusion of deuterium and tritium nuclei to release energy. Due to the very large temperatures involved, it is essential to isolate the plasma from the device walls to prevent structural damage and the external magnetic fields play a fundamental role in achieving this confinement. In realistic settings, the physical mechanisms governing plasma behavior are highly complex, involving numerous uncertain parameters and intricate particle interactions, such as collisions, that significantly affect both confinement efficiency and overall stability. In this work, we address particularly these challenges by proposing a robust feedback control strategy designed to steer the plasma towards a desired spatial region, despite the presence of uncertainties. From a modeling perspective, we consider a collisional plasma described by a Vlasov-Poisson-BGK system, which accounts for a self-consistent electric field and a strong external magnetic field, while incorporating uncertainty in the model. A key feature of the proposed control strategy is its independence from the random parameter, making it particularly suitable for practical applications. A series of numerical simulations confirms the effectiveness of our approach and demonstrates the ability of external magnetic fields to successfully confine plasma away from the device boundaries, even in the presence of uncertain conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对存在不确定性的碰撞等离子体，提出一种不依赖随机参数的鲁棒反馈控制策略，并通过数值模拟验证其可将等离子体引导至期望空间区域、利用外部磁场实现远离装置边界的约束。
AI.motivation: 磁约束聚变需将高温等离子体限制在装置内并隔离于器壁以避免结构损伤，但实际等离子体行为复杂，包含众多不确定参数及碰撞等粒子相互作用，显著影响约束效率与稳定性，因此需要鲁棒控制方法。
AI.method: 采用描述碰撞等离子体的 Vlasov-Poisson-BGK 系统建模，考虑自洽电场、强外部磁场及模型不确定性；提出一种与随机参数无关的鲁棒反馈控制策略，将等离子体引导至期望空间区域。
AI.result: 数值模拟验证了所提方法的有效性，并表明即使在不确定条件下，外部磁场也能成功将等离子体约束在远离装置边界的位置。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的鲁棒反馈控制策略可在不确定性下将等离子体引导至期望空间区域，且因其不依赖随机参数而适合实际应用；数值结果支持外部磁场在不确定条件下实现有效约束。

title: The 1/4-power law for bounded variation of wall turbulence from the Kármán-Howarth equation
summary: By applying the Kármán-Howarth (KH) equation to turbulent channel flows, we derive the $1/4$-power bounded laws for the peak dissipation and the normalized mean-square streamwise velocity fluctuation. The analysis requires two additional inputs, both standard in the study of turbulent wall flows: the logarithmic mean velocity profile and the near-isotropy of the spatial velocity derivatives. Self-similarity of KH equation yields, for the profile of the mean-square streamwise velocity, the form $c_1 - c_2 (y/δ)^{1/4}$ in the overlap region (Chen and Sreenivasan, 2023), where $δ$ is the half-channel height; it also provides the basis for constructing self-similar profiles for high-order moments of streamwise velocity (Chen and Sreenivasan, 2025). Furthermore, the analysis yields the form $c_1' - c_2' Re^{-1/4}_τ$ for the inner peak of the streamwise mean-square velocity (Chen and Sreenivasan, 2022), and a similar bounded relation for a characteristic wall dissipation (Chen and Sreenivasan, 2021).

AI.tldr: 该文将Kármán-Howarth（KH）方程应用于湍流槽道流，在采用对数平均速度剖面和空间速度导数近各向同性这两个标准输入后，推导出峰值耗散与归一化流向速度均方脉动的1/4次幂有界律，并给出重叠区均方流向速度剖面、流向速度高阶矩自相似剖面、内峰Re_τ标度及特征壁面耗散的有界关系。
AI.motivation: 将KH方程用于湍流槽道流，以推导峰值耗散和归一化流向速度均方脉动的有界标度律，并利用KH方程的自相似性描述重叠区流向速度均方剖面、高阶矩剖面以及内峰和壁面耗散的Reynolds数依赖。摘要未进一步说明工程或理论应用背景。
AI.method: 对湍流槽道流应用KH方程；分析需要两个在湍流壁面流研究中标准的附加输入：对数平均速度剖面和空间速度导数的近各向同性。利用KH方程的自相似性，得到重叠区流向速度均方剖面形式 c1 - c2 (y/δ)^{1/4}，其中δ为半槽道高度；并据此构造流向速度高阶矩的自相似剖面。分析还给出流向速度均方内峰形式 c1' - c2' Re_τ^{-1/4}，以及特征壁面耗散的类似有界关系。摘要未提供推导细节、系数取值或适用Reynolds数范围。
AI.result: 得到峰值耗散和归一化流向速度均方脉动的1/4次幂有界律；重叠区流向速度均方剖面呈 c1 - c2 (y/δ)^{1/4}；可构造流向速度高阶矩的自相似剖面；内峰呈 c1' - c2' Re_τ^{-1/4}；特征壁面耗散具有类似的有界关系。摘要未给出定量验证、误差评估或具体常数。
AI.conclusion: KH方程结合对数平均速度剖面和空间速度导数近各向同性，可导出湍流槽道流中峰值耗散与流向速度均方脉动的1/4次幂有界律，并统一描述重叠区剖面、高阶矩自相似性、内峰Reynolds数标度和特征壁面耗散关系。摘要未提供实验或数值数据验证及常数标定信息。

title: Backward-scattering photoelectron holography of a polar molecule driven by a sub-cycle laser pulse
summary: We investigate photoelectron holographic interference in the polar CO molecule driven by a sub-cycle laser pulse using time-dependent Schrödinger equation simulations and a classical-trajectory-based analysis. The sub-cycle temporal confinement of the driving field enables the forward-scattering holographic (FSH) and backward-scattering holographic (BSH) interference structures in the photoelectron momentum distributions (PMDs) to be clearly distinguished. The FSH fringes exhibit a strong dependence on molecular orientation, which is associated with the orientation-dependent transverse displacement of the ionizing electron wave packet (EWP). Furthermore, the heteronuclear nature of CO results in different FSH fringe shifts for ionization occurring predominantly from the C and O sides of the molecule. In contrast, the curved interference structures in the negative parallel-momentum region are identified as BSH interference arising from the coherent superposition of direct and backward-scattered EWPs. The BSH fringe positions show weak dependence on molecular orientation and remain clearly visible after orientation averaging. We further show that BSH visibility depends on the carrier-envelope phase (CEP) and that the fringes remain discernible after CEP averaging. Moreover, the BSH interference pattern exhibits a systematic dependence on the internuclear separation, demonstrating its sensitivity to molecular geometry. These results highlight the potential of sub-cycle pulse enabled backward-scattering photoelectron holography for probing molecular structure and demonstrate its robustness against molecularorientation and CEP averaging

AI.tldr: 该文利用含时薛定谔方程模拟和经典轨迹分析，研究亚周期激光脉冲驱动极性CO分子产生的光电子全息干涉，区分前向散射全息与后向散射全息，并评估其对分子取向、CEP平均及核间距的依赖。
AI.motivation: 旨在分辨亚周期脉冲下CO分子光电子动量分布中的前向散射全息（FSH）和后向散射全息（BSH）干涉结构，并探索后向散射光电子全息探测分子结构的潜力及其对分子取向和载波包络相位（CEP）平均的稳健性。
AI.method: 采用含时薛定谔方程模拟，并结合基于经典轨迹的分析，使用亚周期激光脉冲驱动极性CO分子，研究光电子动量分布中的全息干涉结构。
AI.result: 亚周期场的时间限制使FSH和BSH干涉结构可清晰区分。FSH条纹强烈依赖分子取向，并与电离电子波包的取向依赖横向位移相关；CO的异核性质导致C侧和O侧电离对应的FSH条纹位移不同。负平行动量区域的弯曲干涉结构被认定为直接与后向散射电子波包相干叠加形成的BSH干涉；BSH条纹位置对分子取向依赖较弱，且在取向平均后仍清晰可见。BSH可见度依赖CEP，并在CEP平均后仍可辨认；BSH干涉图样随核间距呈系统性变化，显示其对分子几何的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 亚周期脉冲实现的后向散射光电子全息可用于探测分子结构，并对分子取向平均和CEP平均表现出稳健性。

title: A spherical body in plasma simulated with adaptive mesh and algorithm refinement
summary: An absorbing sphere in a weakly ionized plasma is the oldest kinetic problem of probe theory. It presents key difficulties in plasma simulation: disparate velocity scales, orbital motion, phase-space regions that no characteristic of the plasma reaches, a boundary set by a kinetic flux balance, and collisions that qualitatively change the answer. We use this problem to demonstrate the Plasma Adaptive Mesh and Algorithm Refinement (PAMAR) framework introduced in a companion paper. Electrons and ions have separate solvers on their own adaptive $(r,v,μ)$ octrees, or on reduced phase spaces at the angular-moment level (Fokker-Planck and two-stream models), coupled through a radial Poisson field solver. Two exact references, a method of characteristics for the collisionless problem and integration along the orbits for elastic scattering, audit the solvers. We compute the current-voltage characteristic of the probe on both electron and ion branches, and the profiles of the potential and of the moments of both species agree with the exact solution. Far from the sphere, the potential follows the Coulomb law in neither limit: it falls as $r^{-2}$ without collisions and as $r^{-1}$ only beyond the ion mean free path. With elastic electron scattering, the kinetic solver follows the exact dependence of the collected current on the mean free path, from free flight toward diffusion, to 1 percent. Finally, we demonstrate the ion model selection cell by cell, using a fluid model coupled to the kinetic solver, with the interface set by the pressure anisotropy; with charge exchange, a sensor of ion trapping is also needed. According to exact solutions, the ion anisotropy extends to several probe radii, much farther than the electron loss cone.

AI.tldr: 该文以弱电离等离子体中的吸收球探针这一经典动理学问题为基准，展示PAMAR框架：电子与离子在各自自适应(r,v,μ)八叉树或降维相空间上求解，并通过径向Poisson场耦合；结果与无碰撞及弹性散射的精确解一致，并揭示远场势与离子模型选择的动理学特征。
AI.motivation: 吸收球是探针理论中最古老的动理学问题，包含速度尺度差异大、轨道运动、无等离子体特征到达的相空间区域、由动理学通量平衡确定的边界以及会定性改变结果的碰撞等关键困难；作者希望用该问题演示 companion paper 中提出的PAMAR框架。
AI.method: 电子和离子采用分离求解器，运行在各自的自适应(r,v,μ)八叉树上，或运行在角动量层面降维的相空间上（Fokker-Planck模型和双流模型），并通过径向Poisson场求解器耦合。使用两种精确参考解审计求解器：无碰撞问题的方法 of characteristics，以及弹性散射的轨道积分。计算探针电子支和离子支的电流-电压特性，并比较电势及两物种矩的剖面。进一步将流体模型与动理学求解器逐单元耦合，以压力各向异性确定离子模型选择界面；在电荷交换情形下还需离子俘获传感器。
AI.result: 电势与两物种矩的剖面和精确解一致；探针电子支与离子支的电流-电压特性均被计算。远场电势不遵循两种简单极限：无碰撞时按r^{-2}下降，而仅在超过离子平均自由程后才按r^{-1}下降。存在弹性电子散射时，动理学求解器在自由飞行向扩散过渡范围内对收集电流随平均自由程的依赖与精确结果吻合到1%。逐单元离子模型选择得到演示，界面由压力各向异性设定；电荷交换下还需离子俘获传感器。按精确解，离子各向异性延伸到数个探针半径，远大于电子损失锥。
AI.conclusion: PAMAR框架能够处理吸收球探针问题中的多尺度动理学、碰撞与模型自适应耦合，并通过与精确解对比验证了电势、矩剖面及电流-电压特性的可靠性；结果还表明远场电势、电子散射电流和离子各向异性具有非平凡且需动理学描述的行为。摘要未提供更详细的数值参数和误差统计。

title: Local topology hallucinations in universal machine-learned interatomic potentials
summary: Predicting metastable states with universal machine-learned interatomic potentials requires that they preserve the minima and saddles of the reference potential-energy surface. Here we identify local topology hallucination, in which distinct model minima relax into the same reference basin. This failure arises from mode-selective curvature-sign errors shared by MACE, CHGNet and M3GNet. Curvature signs predicted by two of the three models agreed with density-functional calculations in 55 of 57 positive but only 5 of 56 negative cases. In LiGe$_2$S, two MACE minima connected by a verified saddle relaxed into one density-functional basin. Reference relaxation likewise returned nine of ten selected model minima to their reference basins. A directional test with two displaced reference calculations rejected 9 of 12 prospectively tested model instabilities. Model agreement alone therefore cannot establish that predicted minima are distinct metastable states.

AI.tldr: 论文指出机器学习原子间势存在“局部拓扑幻觉”：不同模型极小值会弛豫到同一参考势能面盆地，因此模型间一致并不足以证明预测的极小值对应不同亚稳态。
AI.motivation: 预测亚稳态要求通用机器学习原子间势保留参考势能面的极小值和鞍点；作者关注模型是否会把不同极小值错误映射到同一参考盆地。
AI.method: 作者识别局部拓扑幻觉，分析MACE、CHGNet和M3GNet共享的模式选择性曲率符号错误；将模型预测的曲率符号与密度泛函计算比较，并进行参考弛豫测试、LiGe$_2$S案例分析和含两个位移参考计算的方向性测试。
AI.result: 三个模型中两个模型的曲率符号与密度泛函计算在57个正例中一致55个，但在56个负例中仅一致5个；LiGe$_2$S中由已验证鞍点连接的两个MACE极小值弛豫到同一密度泛函盆地；参考弛豫使10个所选模型极小值中的9个回到其参考盆地；方向性测试拒绝了12个前瞻测试的模型不稳定性中的9个。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠模型间一致性不能确认预测的极小值是彼此不同的亚稳态；需要针对参考势能面的拓扑保真性进行验证。

title: Scale-aware composite forcing enhances forward energy transfer in lattice Boltzmann simulations of forced homogeneous isotropic turbulence
summary: In forced homogeneous isotropic turbulence (FHIT), conventional large-scale forcing sustains statistical stationarity but offers limited control over energy at intermediate scales. We propose a scale-aware composite forcing strategy for the lattice Boltzmann method, combining large-scale random forcing with feedback aligned with an intermediate-scale velocity field extracted by composite filtering. The magnitude of the cross-power spectrum between feedback and filtered velocity is concentrated in the target band, with a time-averaged fraction of 72.26%-74.56%. Feedback increases energy in both target and high-wavenumber bands, with larger relative gains at high wavenumbers. At feedback strengths $α$ = 1%, 3%, 5%, and 7%, the target-band energy fraction increases by 6.29%, 11.65%, 18.99%, and 19.89% relative to the baseline. The mean forward nonlinear energy flux across K = 12 rises to 1.18, 1.54, 2.32, and 3.06 times its baseline value, with larger relative increases than across K = 4. As $α$ increases from 0% to 7%, the mean Taylor-microscale Reynolds number rises from 73.94 to 97.86 and enstrophy increases by 181.98%, while longitudinal velocity-gradient skewness shifts toward zero and standardized velocity and normalized Q'-R' distributions largely retain their shapes. Mean $k_{\max}η$ values of 1.01 and 0.90 at 5% and 7% feedback indicate an approaching resolution limit and a risk of under-resolution, respectively. At approximately matched dissipation rates, 5% feedback gives a target-band energy fraction of 32.36%, versus 27.55% under enhanced large-scale forcing, and a post-transient forward flux across K = 12 generally 2.17-2.39 times larger. The strategy thus enables targeted control of energy distribution and nonlinear transfer, with feedback strength constrained by small-scale resolution.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于格子Boltzmann方法的尺度感知复合强迫策略，将大尺度随机强迫与基于复合滤波提取的中尺度速度反馈结合，以靶向调控强制均匀各向同性湍流中的能量分布与非线性能流；反馈增强目标带能量和正向能流，但受小尺度分辨率限制。
AI.motivation: 传统大尺度强迫虽能在强制均匀各向同性湍流中维持统计定常，但对中间尺度能量的控制能力有限，因此需要一种能够尺度感知地调节中尺度能量及非线性传递的强迫策略。
AI.method: 在格子Boltzmann方法框架下，将大尺度随机强迫与反馈项结合；反馈项与通过复合滤波提取的中尺度速度场对齐。研究考察反馈强度α=1%、3%、5%、7%的影响，并在耗散率近似匹配条件下，与增强大尺度强迫方案进行比较。
AI.result: 反馈与滤波速度的交叉功率谱幅值集中于目标波段，时间平均占比为72.26%-74.56%。α=1%、3%、5%、7%时，目标带能量分数较基线分别提高6.29%、11.65%、18.99%、19.89%；跨K=12的平均正向非线性能流升至基线的1.18、1.54、2.32、3.06倍，且相对增幅大于跨K=4处。α从0%增至7%时，平均Taylor微尺度Reynolds数由73.94升至97.86，enstrophy增加181.98%，纵向速度梯度偏度趋近于零，标准化速度分布与归一化Q'-R'分布基本保持形状。5%和7%反馈下平均k_maxη分别为1.01和0.90，表明接近分辨率极限及存在欠解析风险。耗散率近似匹配时，5%反馈的目标带能量分数为32.36%，增强大尺度强迫为27.55%；瞬态后跨K=12的正向能流约为后者的2.17-2.39倍。
AI.conclusion: 该复合强迫策略能够对能量分布和非线性传递实施靶向控制；但反馈强度受小尺度分辨率约束，需在目标带能量增益与解析度之间权衡。

title: Photonic Maxwells demon as an energy resource
summary: We propose a new realization of Maxwells demon for photons and its use as an energy resource. The starting point is a multilayer dielectric mirror that transmits photons within a certain wavelength band but reflects photons at longer wavelengths, followed by a material that irreversibly converts the wavelength. A 3D box constructed from these one-way mirrors is a self-acting Maxwells demon for photons. The first case considered is a one-way mirror for visible photons, converting blue to red as an example. The next case is a one-way mirror that transmits visible light but reflects infrared light, followed by a perfect blackbody. We analyze a 3D box with such mirrors as walls to accumulate and store blackbody radiation. Applications include solar-powered thermal energy and solar-powered thermophotovoltaics. The latter case would combine the 3D box with an ultra-low bandgap semiconductor photovoltaic cell inside. In the ideal optical limit, radiation can enter the box but cannot return through the entrance channel after conversion, allowing repeated photon recycling and nearly complete optical utilization. This can in principle move the conversion efficiency toward the thermodynamic limit for solar-energy conversion, the Landsberg limit of 93.3%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种光子版麦克斯韦妖：由多层介质一维单向镜与不可逆波长转换材料构成三维盒，可单向收集并储存光子/黑体辐射，并探索其在太阳能热利用和热光伏中的应用。
AI.motivation: 将麦克斯韦妖实现为光子体系中的自作用单向能量门，并把这种结构用作能量资源，以提高太阳能转换与热光伏的利用率。
AI.method: 采用可透射特定波段、反射更长波长光子的多层介质镜，后接不可逆波长转换材料；用这类单向镜构成三维盒。分析两类情形：可见光单向镜将蓝光转换为红光；以及透射可见光、反射红外光并后接完美黑体的单向镜，用于积累和储存黑体辐射；热光伏情形则在盒内集成超低带隙半导体光伏电池。
AI.result: 在理想光学极限下，辐射可进入盒内，经波长转换后无法从入口通道返回，从而实现重复光子回收和近乎完全的光学利用；论文指出这原则上可使太阳能转换效率趋近Landsberg极限93.3%。摘要未提供实验测量或具体效率数值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种自作用光子麦克斯韦妖的概念设计，并论证其用于太阳能热能和太阳能热光伏、逼近热力学极限的潜力；摘要未给出实验验证或工程实现细节。

title: Experimental observation of higher-harmonic generation of whistler waves in magnetized plasma of Large Volume Plasma Device
summary: We report the higher-harmonic generation of whistler waves using a loop antenna in the Large Volume Plasma Device (LVPD). The antenna is energized using a pulse-forming network (PFN), and the excited magnetic fluctuations are measured using a three-axis B-dot probe. Experiments are performed in a moderate-density ($n_e \sim 1-2 \times 10^{17}\ \text{m}^{-3}$), low-temperature ($T_e \sim 2-5\ \text{eV}$) argon plasma in a uniform axial magnetic field ($B_z \sim 6.2\ \text{G}$). A Helmholtz coil is employed to investigate the dependence of the wave response and propagation on the local magnetic-field configuration. A clear distinction between wave characteristics is observed in the absence and presence of plasma: in plasma, the excited wave shows a significant $δB_y$ component along with $δB_x$, indicating polarization. In addition to the fundamental frequency, distinct spectral peaks are observed at $300\ \text{kHz}$, $450\ \text{kHz}$, and $600\ \text{kHz}$. These harmonics indicate nonlinear wave-plasma interactions, and bicoherence analysis further provides evidence of nonlinear coupling between the observed frequency components. The spatial propagation of the wave was systematically diagnosed using a linear array of five identical B-dot probes. Spatial cross-correlation analysis reveals strong structural coherence during wave propagation, allowing the explicit experimental determination of the wave phase velocity ($V_{ph}$) and parallel wave number ($k_{\parallel}$) for the generated higher harmonics. The measured propagation is oblique at an angle of approximately $48^\circ$ with respect to the background magnetic field, and the experimental dispersion relation agrees with the cold-plasma oblique whistler dispersion relation within experimental uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 在大型体积等离子体装置（LVPD）中，研究利用环形天线激发哨声波的高次谐波：除基频外观察到300、450和600 kHz谱峰，双相干分析支持非线性耦合；五探针阵列测得波以约48°斜向传播，实验色散关系与冷等离子体斜哨声波色散关系在实验不确定度内一致。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确说明研究动机；所报道的工作聚焦于实验研究哨声波高次谐波的产生、非线性波-等离子体相互作用，以及局域磁场配置对波响应和传播的影响。
AI.method: 在中等密度（n_e约1–2×10^17 m^-3）、低温度（T_e约2–5 eV）的氩等离子体和均匀轴向磁场（B_z约6.2 G）中，用脉冲形成网络（PFN）激励环形天线，并用三轴B-dot探针测量激发的磁涨落；用Helmholtz线圈研究局域磁场配置对波响应和传播的影响；用五个相同B-dot探针组成的线性阵列诊断空间传播，并通过空间互相关和双相干分析确定相位速度、平行波数、传播角及色散关系。
AI.result: 有等离子体时，激发波除δB_x外还出现显著δB_y分量，表明存在极化；无等离子体与有等离子体条件下的波特征明显不同。除基频外，观察到300 kHz、450 kHz和600 kHz的离散谱峰；双相干分析进一步给出这些频率分量间非线性耦合的证据。空间互相关显示波传播具有强结构相干性，并实验确定了高次谐波的相位速度（V_ph）和平行波数（k_∥）；测得传播相对背景磁场斜约48°，实验色散关系与冷等离子体斜哨声波色散关系在实验不确定度内一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明所观测的高次谐波与非线性波-等离子体相互作用有关，并实验证实了具有结构相干性的斜向传播；测得的色散关系支持冷等离子体斜哨声波描述。摘要未提供V_ph、k_∥的具体数值及实验误差范围。

title: Parametrised-Quadratic Interface Reconstruction and Geometric Velocity Extension in the Volume-of-Fluid Framework
summary:
A conservative Volume-of-Fluid (VOF) framework using local parametric-curve interface reconstruction (PI-VOF) is developed for geometric interface propagation on fixed Cartesian grids. While VOF methods achieve conservative and second-order accurate interface advection under prescribed velocity fields, normal-velocity-driven interface propagation requires the interfacial velocity to be extended to neighbouring staggered-grid locations.
  Existing studies on interface evolution employ auxiliary distance functions, kernel smoothers, or high-resolution VOF in multiple grids to compute propagation velocities and address first-order-accuracy limitations. In contrast, PI-VOF directly employs higher-order parametric interface geometry for local normal-velocity extension, aiming to achieve second-order accurate interface evolution on fixed Cartesian grids. The resulting velocity field is employed in conservative geometric advection using a directionally split Eulerian-implicit and Lagrangian-explicit (EI-LE) scheme, while the reconstructed interface provides the geometric information required for curvature evaluation and the ghost-fluid finite-difference discretisation of sharp interfacial Dirichlet conditions. Static reconstruction and reversible-vortex advection tests demonstrate higher-order interface geometry and approximately second-order transport convergence, with mass conservation to the chosen tolerance on refined grids. Prescribed normal-velocity and curvature-dependent propagation tests establish near second-order convergence. Coupled Stefan benchmarks involving capillarity and attachment kinetics demonstrate approximately second-order thermal convergence and decreasing interface errors under mesh refinement. The results establish a geometric formulation connecting conservative VOF transport, local normal-velocity extension, and sharp Stefan conditions for evolving interfaces.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于局部参数曲线界面重构的保守VOF框架PI-VOF，用于固定笛卡尔网格上的几何界面传播；该方法将界面法向速度局部延拓至交错网格，并结合方向分裂EI-LE保守几何输运、曲率评估和ghost-fluid尖锐界面离散，在多种测试中实现近二阶收敛并保持质量守恒。
AI.motivation: 常规VOF在给定速度场下可实现保守且二阶精度的界面输运，但由法向速度驱动的界面传播需要把界面速度延拓到相邻交错网格位置；现有辅助距离函数、核光滑或多网格高分辨率VOF方法在计算传播速度时受一阶精度限制。作者希望直接利用高阶参数界面几何进行局部法向速度延拓，从而在固定笛卡尔网格上实现二阶精度的界面演化。
AI.method: PI-VOF采用局部参数曲线进行高阶界面重构，并直接利用重构界面几何完成局部法向速度延拓；所得速度场用于方向分裂的欧拉隐式-拉格朗日显式（EI-LE）保守几何输运。重构界面同时提供曲率计算和ghost-fluid有限差分所需的几何信息，以施加尖锐界面Dirichlet条件；该方法还用于包含毛细作用和附着动力学的Stefan基准问题。
AI.result: 静态重构与可逆涡输运测试显示更高阶的界面几何和约二阶的输运收敛，细化网格上的质量守恒达到所选容差；给定法向速度和曲率相关传播测试呈接近二阶收敛；耦合Stefan基准显示约二阶热收敛，界面误差随网格细化而下降。摘要未给出具体误差常数、网格规模和容差数值。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，该几何表述将保守VOF输运、局部法向速度延拓与尖锐Stefan界面条件联系起来，为固定笛卡尔网格上的演化界面提供了保守、近二阶的几何传播框架；更广泛的定量精度与适用性仍需结合全文数据判断。

title: Wake-Powered Spreading of Encapsulated Drops Impacting Under Liquid
summary: A drop impacting a wall in air spreads by converting its own kinetic energy into surface energy. We show that this picture fails when the wall is submerged in liquid. Millimetric perfluoropolyether drops, bare or encapsulated in an ultrathin silicone-oil shell, impacting a glass wall in water are flattened by the squeeze flow in the draining gap and shed most of their kinetic energy before impact. Nevertheless, they spread to more than twice their diameter on a water lubrication film that never ruptures, creating more surface energy than their entire kinetic and gravitational energy could supply. A two-stage energy scaling resolves this deficit. The liquid set in motion in the drop's wake supplies more than 90\% of the energy for spreading, so that the maximum spreading is governed by the Weber number of the ambient liquid rather than that of the drop. The shell acts mainly through its interfacial tension, while its biaxial-extension dissipation, negligible before impact, becomes appreciable during spreading.

AI.tldr: 浸没壁面上的液滴铺展不遵循空气中“自身动能转化为表面能”的图景：液滴撞击前被排水间隙的挤压流压扁并损失大部分动能，但铺展所需能量主要来自尾流驱动的环境液体，最大铺展由环境液体的Weber数控制。
AI.motivation: 检验空气中液滴撞壁铺展的能量图景在壁面浸没于液体时是否仍成立，并解释裸全氟聚醚液滴及带超薄硅油壳液滴为何能在自身能量不足时仍大幅铺展。
AI.method: 以毫米级全氟聚醚液滴（裸滴或包裹超薄硅油壳）撞击水中的玻璃壁，分析排水间隙挤压流、未破裂水润滑膜及两阶段能量标度；比较液滴与环境液体的Weber数，并评估壳的界面张力和双轴拉伸耗散。摘要未提供具体撞击速度、液滴尺寸范围及测量手段。
AI.result: 液滴撞击前被排水间隙中的挤压流压扁，损失大部分动能；但仍可在从未破裂的水润滑膜上铺展至直径两倍以上，产生超过其全部动能与重力能之和的表面能。两阶段能量标度表明，尾流中运动的液体提供超过90%的铺展能量，最大铺展由环境液体Weber数而非液滴Weber数决定。壳主要通过界面张力起作用；其双轴拉伸耗散在撞击前可忽略，在铺展阶段变得显著。
AI.conclusion: 浸没条件下液滴撞壁铺展不能用空气中的单相能量图景描述，需采用包含环境液体尾流供能的两阶段能量标度；最大铺展判据应以环境液体Weber数为主，并考虑超薄壳的界面张力及铺展中的双轴拉伸耗散。

title: Bandwidth-tunable thermal emitter via dynamic resonator coupling and loss
summary: We demonstrate a dynamically tunable omnidirectional thermal emitter that can be switched from a narrowband emission state to a broadband state. The structure is a metal-backed multilayer with subwavelength thickness across the mid-infrared, which forms an angle-insensitive (up to 60°) optical cavity with one input port. We used an ultrathin VO2 layer to dynamically switch the coupling and loss coefficients of this optical cavity, resulting in narrowband emission from the vibrational mode of a polar dielectric layer that is part of the multilayer stack when the VO2 is in its insulating phase, and broadband emission from a nearly impedance-matched cavity when the VO2 is switched to its lossy metallic phase. We fabricated the structure around a free-standing silicon membrane and integrated it onto a printed circuit board (PCB), which enabled electrical switching of the emitter at the ten-to-hundred millisecond scale, and can be used for free-space identification, tagging, or communication.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种可动态调控的全向热辐射器，可在窄带与宽带发射状态之间切换；其核心是金属背衬的亚波长多层结构，利用超薄VO2层的绝缘-金属相变改变光学腔的耦合与损耗，并通过悬空硅膜与PCB集成实现电切换。
AI.motivation: 实现热辐射状态的动态切换，并获得角度不敏感、可在中红外工作的全向热发射器，以用于自由空间识别、标记或通信。
AI.method: 采用中红外亚波长厚度的金属背衬多层结构，形成最多60°角度不敏感、单输入端口的光学腔；引入超薄VO2层动态切换腔的耦合系数和损耗系数。VO2处于绝缘相时，由多层结构中极性电介质层的振动模式产生窄带发射；切换至有损金属相时，由接近阻抗匹配的腔产生宽带发射。器件围绕悬空硅膜制备并集成到印刷电路板（PCB）上，实现电切换。
AI.result: 实现了可从窄带发射切换到宽带发射的动态全向热辐射器，结构对入射角不敏感（最大60°），并可通过PCB集成进行电切换，切换时间尺度为十到数百毫秒。摘要未给出具体发射率、效率或光谱带宽等定量指标。
AI.conclusion: 利用VO2相变调控金属背衬多层光学腔的耦合与损耗，可实现窄带/宽带可切换的全向热发射，并具备电驱动快速切换能力，适用于自由空间识别、标记或通信。摘要未提供长期稳定性、能耗或实际系统验证等结论。

title: Embedded Trigger Control System for Wave--Plasma Interaction Experiments in Large Volume Plasma Device
summary: {Magnetic-field control and synchronization are essential requirements in laboratory plasma experiments investigating wave propagation and plasma instabilities. In this work, an Embedded Trigger Control System (ETCS) has been designed and implemented for synchronized operation of a pulsed Helmholtz coil system and a broadband whistler-wave exciter in the Large Volume Plasma Device--Upgrade (LVPD-U). The experimental configuration employs an electrostatically shielded loop antenna driven by a thyratron-switched pulse-forming network to launch broadband whistler waves in the frequency range of approximately 150~kHz to 5~MHz. Simultaneously, a pulsed Helmholtz coil capable of generating magnetic fields up to $\pm150$~G is used to modify the local magnetic topology and create transient magnetic-null configurations. The developed ETCS utilizes the controlled evolution of the Helmholtz circuit $L/R$ time constant through the introduction of a lumped series inductor, enabling precise magnetic-field ramping and dynamic timing control. A microcontroller-based trigger architecture determines the desired firing instant from the calibrated current evolution of the Helmholtz circuit and synchronizes wave excitation with a prescribed magnetic-field amplitude. The system extends the effective circuit time constant by more than an order of magnitude, allowing accurate and repeatable wave launching during controlled magnetic-field evolution. The implemented approach provides a simple, reliable, and versatile synchronization platform for wave--plasma interaction studies requiring precise temporal coordination between pulsed magnetic-field generation and wave excitation.

AI.tldr: 本文为LVPD-U装置设计并实现嵌入式触发控制系统ETCS，用于同步脉冲亥姆霍兹线圈与宽带哨声波激励器，通过增大串联电感调控L/R时间常数，实现磁场精确爬升与按预设磁场幅度触发波发射。
AI.motivation: 实验室等离子体实验中研究波传播和等离子体不稳定性需要可靠的磁场控制与同步；本文旨在解决脉冲磁场产生与波激励之间的精确时间协调问题。
AI.method: 在LVPD-U中构建ETCS，同步脉冲亥姆霍兹线圈和宽带哨声波激励器。激励器采用静电屏蔽环形天线，由闸流管开关脉冲形成网络驱动，在约150 kHz至5 MHz发射宽带哨声波；脉冲亥姆霍兹线圈可产生最高±150 G磁场，用于改变局部磁拓扑并形成瞬态磁零点。ETCS通过引入集总串联电感控制亥姆霍兹电路L/R时间常数的演化，实现磁场精确爬升和动态定时；基于微控制器的触发架构根据校准后的线圈电流演化确定触发时刻，并将波激励与规定磁场幅度同步。
AI.result: 该系统将有效电路时间常数扩展超过一个数量级，使波发射能够在受控磁场演化过程中准确且可重复地进行；摘要未提供其他定量实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 所实现方法为需要脉冲磁场产生与波激励精确时间协调的波—等离子体相互作用研究提供了一种简单、可靠且通用的同步平台。

title: GranularGPT: Natural-Language-Driven End-to-End Discrete Element Method Simulations
summary: Discrete element method (DEM) simulations are widely used to investigate granular and particulate systems, but their application often requires specialized expertise in particle physics, numerical modelling, and simulation post-processing. Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to simplify these workflows by enabling users to interact with simulation tools through natural language. This study offers GranularGPT, an LLM-assisted agentic framework for end-to-end DEM simulation workflows, from natural-language problem descriptions to simulation execution and automated post-processing. The framework enables users to generate DEM simulation cases, execute and monitor simulations, and automatically extract and report physical and process-level metrics. Evaluation across 60 normal-condition cases covering 12 DEM scenarios and parameter variations achieve a simulation success rate of 91.7%. In the error-handling evaluation, all 10 repairable errors are detected and 9 are successfully resolved, while all 5 non-repairable cases are correctly identified and reported. The framework automatically extracts a range of DEM-relevant metrics, including particle size distributions, packing and density measures, velocity profiles, discharge rates, mixing indices, contact force characteristics, and thermal quantities. GranularGPT provides a foundation for improving the accessibility and efficiency of DEM simulation workflows while reducing the specialized expertise required for their operation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GranularGPT，一个由大语言模型辅助的智能体框架，用于完成从自然语言问题描述到 DEM 仿真执行和自动后处理的端到端工作流；在 60 个正常条件案例上达到 91.7% 的仿真成功率，并在可修复与不可修复错误处理评估中表现良好。
AI.motivation: DEM 仿真广泛用于颗粒与颗粒物系统研究，但应用通常需要颗粒物理、数值建模和仿真后处理方面的专业知识。大语言模型为通过自然语言交互简化仿真工具工作流提供了新机会。
AI.method: 提出 GranularGPT 的 LLM 辅助智能体框架，支持用户生成 DEM 仿真案例、执行并监控仿真、自动提取并报告物理与过程级指标。评估覆盖 12 个 DEM 场景及参数变化的 60 个正常条件案例，并开展包含 10 个可修复错误和 5 个不可修复错误的错误处理评估；摘要未提供具体模型架构和实现细节。
AI.result: 正常条件案例的仿真成功率为 91.7%。错误处理评估中，10 个可修复错误全部被检测到，其中 9 个被成功解决；5 个不可修复案例均被正确识别并报告。框架可自动提取粒径分布、堆积与密度指标、速度分布、卸料速率、混合指数、接触力特征和热学量等 DEM 相关指标。
AI.conclusion: GranularGPT 为提升 DEM 仿真工作流的可访问性和效率、降低操作所需的专业知识门槛提供了基础。

title: Resolvent-based modeling of turbulent flow over multilayer compliant surfaces
summary: Compliant coatings offer a passive approach to modifying near-wall turbulence and potentially reducing skin-friction drag, but high-fidelity exploration of the coupled parameter space is costly. We develop a two-way coupled resolvent-Galerkin framework for turbulent channel flow over finite-thickness, layered viscoelastic coatings. The fluid is modeled using the Navier-Stokes equations linearized about a turbulent mean state, while the solid is represented by a through-thickness Galerkin discretization of the elastodynamic equations. The solid response is condensed into a spectral surface-impedance operator at the fluid-solid interface. At $Re_τ= 180$, stiff panels approach the rigid-wall response, whereas more compliant panels modify the low-rank response associated with the near-wall cycle. A Reynolds-number study shows that panels with fixed nondimensional material stiffness can produce different responses depending on whether their thickness scales with inner or outer flow length scales. The influence of viscoelastic damping is examined across low- and high-frequency regimes, where stiffness-proportional damping alters the high-frequency fractional-energy distribution, while the low-frequency distribution remains relatively insensitive to damping. For multilayer panels, the fluid-facing material determines the interfacial wave speed, while the subsurface stiffness distribution modifies the panel's effective thickness. Temporal stability analysis identifies regions of parameter space where a steady harmonic response is relevant and regions where instabilities grow. Finally, a leading-order, covariance-based drag-estimation framework relates the coupled response to changes in the mean flow and to the estimated skin-friction drag. Together, these tools provide a basis for screening coating designs and selecting candidates for high-fidelity simulations and experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了用于湍流槽道流中有限厚度分层黏弹性涂层的双向耦合 resolvent-Galerkin 分析框架，在 Re_τ=180 下考察刚度、厚度尺度、黏弹性阻尼、多层结构及时间稳定性，并给出基于协方差的阻力估计方法；结果表明刚性面板趋近刚性壁响应，柔性面板改变近壁循环的低秩响应，涂层响应受厚度缩放方式、阻尼频段和层状材料分布影响。
AI.motivation: 柔性涂层可被动改变近壁湍流并可能降低表面摩擦阻力，但高保真地探索其耦合参数空间成本很高，因此需要低成本、可系统筛选涂层设计的分析工具。
AI.method: 采用双向耦合的 resolvent-Galerkin 框架研究有限厚度分层黏弹性涂层上的湍流槽道流：流体用围绕湍流平均态线性化的 Navier-Stokes 方程描述，固体用沿厚度方向的 Galerkin 离散的弹性动力学方程表示，并将固体响应凝聚为流固界面处的谱表面阻抗算子；研究包括 Re_τ=180 下的响应、雷诺数对固定无量纲材料刚度但厚度按内尺度或外尺度缩放的影响、低频与高频下的黏弹性阻尼、多层面板、时间稳定性分析，以及领先阶的基于协方差的阻力估计框架。
AI.result: 在 Re_τ=180 时，刚性较强的面板接近刚性壁响应，而更柔顺的面板会改变与近壁循环相关的低秩响应；固定无量纲材料刚度的面板会因厚度按内尺度或外尺度缩放而呈现不同响应；刚度比例阻尼会改变高频分数能量分布，而低频分布对阻尼相对不敏感；多层面板中面向流体的材料决定界面波速，次表面刚度分布改变面板有效厚度；时间稳定性分析识别出稳态谐响应相关区域和失稳增长区域；基于协方差的阻力估计将耦合响应与平均流变化及估计的表面摩擦阻力联系起来。
AI.conclusion: 这些工具为筛选涂层设计并选择用于高保真模拟和实验的候选方案提供了基础；摘要未给出具体的减阻数值或实验验证结果。

title: A microscopic revision of the rate equations of a heavily erbium-doped fiber laser
summary: Heavily erbium-doped fiber lasers can exhibit self-pulsing induced by interacting ion pairs, which was found in numerous experiments and supported by modeling. However, conventional rate-equation models rely on phenomenological parameters with an unclear microscopic origin. We derive a rate-equation model using a Lindblad master equation describing isolated erbium ions and interacting ion pairs coupled to a single cavity mode, with cooperative upconversion represented by an effective dissipative process. In the strong-dephasing limit, adiabatic elimination of coherences and ensemble averaging yield a closed system of equations for the cavity photon number, isolated-ion inversion, and pair populations. We show that in the same limit the pair-cavity coupling constant reduces to that of two independent ions, without superradiant or subradiant contributions. The resulting equations retain spontaneous emission, which provides a photon-number floor between pulses and substantially affects the laser pulsing dynamics. Numerical analysis reveals self-pulsing within finite pump-rate intervals and identifies the region of self-pulsing as a function of the upconversion rate and pair fraction. The model thus establishes a microscopic basis for analyzing self-pulsing in heavily erbium-doped fiber lasers.

AI.tldr: 该文从Lindblad主方程推导重掺铒光纤激光器的约化速率方程，将合作上转换表示为有效耗散，并在强退相干极限下得到描述腔光子数、孤立离子反转和离子对布居的封闭方程组，进而数值分析自脉冲行为。
AI.motivation: 常规速率方程模型依赖微观起源不清的现象学参数，因此需要为离子对相互作用诱导的自脉冲建立微观基础。
AI.method: 从描述孤立铒离子及相互作用离子对与单腔模耦合的Lindblad主方程出发，将合作上转换表示为有效耗散过程；在强退相干极限下绝热消去相干并进行系综平均，得到腔光子数、孤立离子反转和离子对布居的封闭方程组，同时分析离子对-腔耦合常数及自发辐射的作用。
AI.result: 研究表明，在同一强退相干极限下，离子对-腔耦合常数约化为两个独立离子的耦合常数，不含超辐射或亚辐射贡献；所得方程保留自发辐射，提供脉冲间的光子数下限并显著影响激光脉冲动力学。数值分析发现自脉冲存在于有限泵浦速率区间，并给出自脉冲区域随上转换速率和离子对比例的变化；摘要未提供具体数值区间或实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为重掺铒光纤激光器中自脉冲的分析提供了微观基础。

title: Cold stellarator coils that outlast power plant lifetime
summary: We show that a two order-of-magnitude reduction in stellarator coil peak neutron flux and heating can be achieved by moving coils much farther from the plasma if the plasma shape may change slightly and the vessel shielding is increased. Alternating coil and plasma optimizations move the closest coils of our main design over 25 cm out, without substantial degradation in key engineering and physics requirements. The field error decreases and the plasma boundary moves about 1 cm on average. Such coils would be at 4.2 K, use only one third to half the superconducting tape of the original, and require no replacement during the plant's lifetime. This reduced coil flux and heating could significantly enhance the viability of stellarator power plants.

AI.tldr: 通过将线圈移得更远离等离子体、允许等离子体形状轻微变化并增强真空室屏蔽，可使仿星器线圈峰值中子通量和加热降低两个数量级。交替进行线圈与等离子体优化后，最近线圈外移超过25 cm，关键工程与物理要求未显著退化，场误差下降，等离子体边界平均移动约1 cm；线圈运行于4.2 K，仅使用原设计三分之一至一半的超导带材，且电站寿命期内无需更换。
AI.motivation: 降低仿星器线圈的峰值中子通量和加热，从而显著提升仿星器电站的可行性。
AI.method: 将线圈移至离等离子体更远的位置，允许等离子体形状发生轻微变化并增强真空室屏蔽；采用线圈与等离子体交替优化，使主设计中距离最近的线圈外移超过25 cm。
AI.result: 线圈峰值中子通量和加热降低两个数量级；最近线圈外移超过25 cm，关键工程和物理要求没有实质性退化；场误差减小，等离子体边界平均移动约1 cm；线圈处于4.2 K，仅使用原设计三分之一至一半的超导带材，且电站寿命期内无需更换。
AI.conclusion: 降低线圈通量和加热可显著增强仿星器电站的可行性。

title: FiuMD: Heterogeneous Batching for Coarse-Grained Molecular Dynamics with Neural Network Potentials
summary: FiuMD is a GPU molecular dynamics engine that advances many independent biomolecular simulations as a single batch, even when the systems differ in size, topology, force-field parameters, periodic box, timestep, or thermostat parameters. All systems are concatenated into global tensors, so the classical interaction terms and a shared TorchMD-Net neural network potential are evaluated for the whole batch at once, while each system keeps its own integration and thermostat. FiuMD started as a fork of TorchMD and reworks its system representation, force evaluation, and integration to handle such heterogeneous batches. We test it with coarse-grained C$α$ models of chignolin, Trp-cage, BBL, and $λ$-repressor. In double precision, forces within a heterogeneous batch agree with isolated FiuMD and TorchMD evaluations to within the precision of repeated evaluations, with a maximum relative difference of $7\times10^{-16}$ across 60 systems. Over 1000 steps without a thermostat, batched trajectories deviate by at most $2.5\times10^{-11}$ Angstrom from isolated ones, even when periodic images lie within the neural network cutoff. With a different target temperature for each system of the ensemble, the mean and width of each system's kinetic temperature match the values expected from its own thermostat. We show that when individual simulations are too small to fill the GPU, batching can improve throughput several-fold over TorchMD. On a single GPU, batching four different protein systems achieves a 4.6-7.8-fold speedup per step compared with sequential TorchMD simulations. Compared with sequential homogeneous FiuMD batches, heterogeneous batching provides up to a 4-fold speedup for smaller batches while maintaining comparable performance for larger ones.

AI.tldr: FiuMD 是一个 GPU 分子动力学引擎，可将尺寸、拓扑、力场、周期盒、时间步和恒温器参数各异的多个生物分子模拟合并为异质批次并行计算；在保持精度和各自积分/恒温行为的同时，显著提升小规模独立模拟的 GPU 吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 许多独立生物分子模拟规模较小，单独运行时难以充分利用 GPU；现有方法对尺寸、拓扑、力场参数、周期盒、时间步或恒温器参数不同的体系进行批处理能力不足，因此需要支持异质批次的高效分子动力学引擎。
AI.method: FiuMD 从 TorchMD 分支而来，重做系统表示、力评估和积分流程；将所有体系拼接到全局张量中，一次性评估整个批次的经典相互作用项和共享 TorchMD-Net 神经网络势，同时每个体系保留自己的积分与恒温器。作者用 chignolin、Trp-cage、BBL 和 λ-repressor 的粗粒化 Cα 模型进行测试，并与隔离的 FiuMD 和 TorchMD 评估比较力、轨迹及恒温器统计，同时测量吞吐量。
AI.result: 双精度下，异质批次中的力与隔离 FiuMD 和 TorchMD 评估一致，60 个体系最大相对差异为 7×10^-16；无恒温器运行 1000 步时，批次轨迹相对隔离轨迹偏差至多 2.5×10^-11 Å，即使周期镜像位于神经网络截断内也是如此。各体系设定不同目标温度时，其动能温度的均值和宽度与各自恒温器的预期值匹配。单 GPU 上批处理四个不同蛋白质体系，相比顺序 TorchMD 每步加速 4.6–7.8 倍；相比顺序同质 FiuMD 批次，异质批处理在较小批次上最高加速 4 倍，在较大批次上性能相当。
AI.conclusion: FiuMD 能以异质批次方式高效运行多个不同生物分子模拟，在保持数值精度和各自恒温器行为的同时提高 GPU 利用率和吞吐量，尤其适用于单个模拟规模太小、无法填满 GPU 的场景；摘要未提供更大规模体系、内存开销或长期稳定性等进一步评估。

title: On the relation of secondary motions to large- and very-large-scale motions
summary: The coexistence of secondary motions with large-scale and very-large-scale motions (LSMs/VLSMs) is investigated by direct numerical simulations of turbulent open-channel flow over streamwise-aligned Gaussian ridges, varying the ridge spacing $S$ and height $h$. First, the ridge height controls the secondary-motion strength and thereby the coexistence with VLSMs. VLSMs are suppressed for $h \geqslant 0.05δ$, with $δ$ the open-channel height, and re-emerge at $h = 0.025δ$, where the mean secondary motions are comparable in strength to those over strip-type surfaces. Previously reported differences between strip- and ridge-type surfaces thus reflect secondary-motion strength rather than surface type. Second, proper orthogonal decomposition and conditional averaging reveal instantaneous secondary motions that span approximately $2δ$, fill the channel height irrespective of $S$ and $h$, and are stronger than their mean. These are identified as LSMs spatially locked and amplified by the ridges. Over dense ridges, their alternation between neighbouring ridges yields weak, near-wall confined mean secondary motions, although VLSMs are suppressed over the full channel height. The ridge height thus sets the strength of the locked LSMs, whereas the ridge spacing sets where and for how long they persist. For weak locked LSMs, ridges spaced at their natural spanwise extent increase the VLSM energy, indicating that persistent locked LSMs concatenate into VLSMs. Third, large-scale instantaneous secondary motions persist over dense ridges in the absence of long streaks. This suggests that secondary motions are driven by intermittent cross-sectional motions rather than by long streaks, similar to the streak-less bursts in near-wall turbulence.

AI.tldr: 该文通过直接数值模拟研究流向排列高斯脊上的湍流明渠中次级运动与大尺度/超大尺度运动（LSMs/VLSMs）的共存，系统改变脊间距 S 和脊高 h，并结合本征正交分解（POD）与条件平均。结果表明：脊高决定次级运动强度及 VLSMs 是否被抑制，脊间距决定被脊锁定的 LSMs 的出现位置和持续范围；瞬时大尺度次级运动并不依赖长条带。
AI.motivation: 摘要未单独陈述研究动机；其研究出发点是探究次级运动与 LSMs/VLSMs 的共存机制，并厘清此前条带型与脊型表面之间的差异究竟源于表面类型还是次级运动强度。
AI.method: 对流向排列的高斯脊上的湍流明渠流动开展直接数值模拟，改变脊间距 S 和脊高 h（以明渠高度 δ 无量纲化）；采用本征正交分解（POD）和条件平均识别瞬时次级运动，并分析其与平均次级运动及 VLSMs 能量行为的关系。摘要未提供雷诺数、脊的具体几何参数等数值细节。
AI.result: 脊高控制次级运动强度及与 VLSMs 的共存：当 h ≥ 0.05δ 时 VLSMs 被抑制，而在 h = 0.025δ 时重新出现，此时平均次级运动强度与条带型表面相当；先前的条带型/脊型差异反映的是次级运动强度而非表面类型。POD 和条件平均显示，瞬时次级运动跨度约 2δ，无论 S 和 h 如何均充满槽道高度，且强于平均次级运动，被识别为受脊空间锁定并放大的 LSMs。密集脊上，这些运动在相邻脊间交替，形成弱且近壁受限的平均次级运动，尽管 VLSMs 在整个槽道高度上被抑制。脊高决定锁定 LSMs 的强度，脊间距决定其出现位置和持续时间；在弱锁定 LSMs 条件下，间距等于其自然展向尺度时 VLSM 能量增加，表明持续存在的锁定 LSMs 可串联成 VLSMs。密集脊上即使没有长条带，大尺度瞬时次级运动仍存在。
AI.conclusion: 次级运动可由间歇性横截面运动驱动，而非由长条带驱动，类似近壁湍流中的无条带爆发；脊高与脊间距分别通过锁定 LSMs 的强度和持续性调控次级运动与 VLSMs 的共存。

title: Inverse Design for Nonplanar Conformal Layers
summary: Conformal layering, where a deposited layer follows the nonplanar topography beneath it, arises from both deliberate passivation overlays and imperfect planarization between depositions. However, inverse design methods typically model planar, vertically extruded layers, resulting in geometric discrepancies between the modeled and fabricated structure. To address these discrepancies, we present differentiable mapping functions that incorporate both uniform conformal overlays and partially conformal interlayer dips into a standard inverse design paradigm, requiring no additional design parameters over planar structures. Using these mappings, we design (1) mode-selective GaAs grating reflectors with uniform conformal SiN passivation for high-aspect-ratio VCSELs, reaching differential modal reflectivities of 33.1% (single-etch) and 63.4% (dual-etch), and (2) a dual-layer silicon grating coupler whose upper layer dips up to 40 nm into the lower layer, reaching -0.75 dB coupling efficiency. Modeling conformal layering during optimization, rather than treating it as post-hoc fabrication error, permits direct exploitation of the conformal layering, yielding inherently fabricable and performant designs.

AI.tldr: 本文将均匀共形覆盖层与层间部分共形下陷建模为可微分映射函数，并嵌入标准逆向设计流程，用于设计 GaAs 光栅反射镜和双层硅光栅耦合器，从而在优化阶段直接考虑共形分层并提升结构可制造性与性能。
AI.motivation: 逆向设计通常将层建模为平面、垂直挤出的结构，但实际制造中沉积层会随下方非平面形貌形成共形分层，导致模型与制造结构之间存在几何差异；论文旨在解决该差异，并将共形分层视为可利用的设计因素而非事后制造误差。
AI.method: 提出可微分映射函数，将均匀共形覆盖层和部分共形层间下陷纳入标准逆向设计范式，且相比平面结构不增加额外设计参数。利用该方法设计了两类器件：(1) 面向高深宽比 VCSEL、带均匀共形 SiN 钝化的模式选择 GaAs 光栅反射镜；(2) 上层向底层下陷至多 40 nm 的双层硅光栅耦合器。
AI.result: 所设计的 GaAs 光栅反射镜实现差分模式反射率 33.1%（单刻蚀）和 63.4%（双刻蚀）；双层硅光栅耦合器实现 -0.75 dB 耦合效率。
AI.conclusion: 在优化过程中对共形分层建模，而不是将其仅作为事后制造误差处理，可以直接利用共形分层，获得本征上可制造且性能良好的设计。

title: Analytic Model for Transient Plateau Filling in Vibrational Distributions of Periodically Driven Plasmas
summary: In periodically driven molecular plasmas, the vibrational distribution function is governed by the competition between vibration--vibration (V-V) up-pumping along the anharmonic ladder and vibration--translation (V-T) relaxation, producing the Treanor--Gordiets distribution. When vibrational energy accumulates across cycles faster than V-V exchange can populate the upper levels, the Gordiets plateau remains transiently depleted. Existing algebraic models assume a quasi-steady plateau, whereas exact transient solutions of the nonlinear V-V diffusion equation require the elapsed time since excitation and the source strength, which are unavailable in multidimensional simulations that track only local macroscopic variables. Here, elapsed time is replaced by a local vibrational energy timescale formed from the vibrational energy per molecule and its period-averaged rate of change. This reduces the diffusion equation in level space to an ordinary differential equation solved in closed form without linearization, yielding a level-dependent correction to the steady plateau governed by a single dimensionless group: the number of V-V collisions per energy timescale weighted by the plateau amplitude at the Treanor minimum. The distribution front advances as the square root of this group, and the steady distribution is recovered as the group grows large. Compared with state-to-state master-equation calculations for N$_2$ under nanosecond pulse trains spanning 300-1500 K, 0.041-1 atm, and 1-100 kHz (1440 sampled states), the model reduces the 90th-percentile error in level populations from 1.88 decades for the steady model and 1.32 decades for an adapted self-similar solution to 0.53 decades, at essentially the evaluation cost of the steady model.

AI.tldr: 该文用由局部振动能量及其周期平均变化率构成的振动能量时间尺度替代激发后经历时间，将非线性V-V扩散方程化为可闭式求解的常微分方程，从而以接近稳态模型的成本更准确预测周期驱动分子等离子体中的瞬态Treanor-Gordiets振动分布。
AI.motivation: 现有代数模型假设Gordiets平台处于准稳态，但精确的瞬态非线性V-V扩散方程需要激发后经历时间和源强度，而这些信息在仅跟踪局部宏观变量的多维模拟中不可用；因此需要一种仅依赖局部量、能刻画平台瞬态耗尽的封闭模型。
AI.method: 用每个分子的振动能量及其周期平均变化率构造局部振动能量时间尺度，并以之替代经历时间；将能级空间中的扩散方程约化为常微分方程，在不线性化的情况下给出闭式解。所得解是对稳态平台的能级相关修正，由单一无量纲群控制：每个能量时间尺度内的V-V碰撞数，并以Treanor极小处的平台幅值加权。分布前沿按该无量纲群的平方根推进，当该群增大时恢复稳态分布。
AI.result: 针对N2在纳秒脉冲串下、300-1500 K、0.041-1 atm、1-100 kHz范围内的1440个采样状态，与态-态主方程计算相比，模型将能级布居的90百分位误差从稳态模型的1.88个数量级和 adapted self-similar解的1.32个数量级降至0.53个数量级，且评估成本基本与稳态模型相同。
AI.conclusion: 该模型能够在多维模拟常用的局部宏观变量框架下，以接近稳态模型的计算成本显著提高瞬态振动分布预测精度，并在无量纲群较大时正确退化为稳态分布；摘要未提供N2以外气体或上述条件之外的验证结论。

title: Efficient scheduling of particle annihilation for long-time Wigner simulations
summary: Particle annihilation (PA) plays an indispensable role in alleviating the numerical sign problem in long-time simulations with the Wigner branching random walk (WBRW) method. However, the effect of PA frequency on long-time accuracy remains poorly understood, leaving its choice largely empirical. To provide systematic guidance for PA scheduling, we establish an overall error estimate for PA through a uniform mesh, separating WBRW variance, resampling variance and squared bias. The analysis shows that, beyond merely controlling particle growth, PA replaces the exponential-in-time variance bound with a linear-in-time bound, thereby alleviating the numerical sign problem. It also reveals bias-variance trade-off induced by PA frequency: frequent PA limits variance but can increase accumulated bias. More importantly, building on the newfound error structure, we propose a variance-constrained cost optimization strategy for adaptive PA scheduling across several PA methods. An intrinsic-time reparameterization provides a common clock for variance control, PA scheduling, and branching dynamics under time-dependent potentials. Numerical experiments validate the theoretical variance behavior and bias-variance trade-off, and results of our schedule populate the low-cost regime of the empirical Pareto frontier objecting to balance accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 该文针对Wigner分支随机游走中粒子湮灭频率缺乏系统选取依据的问题，建立误差估计并揭示其偏差—方差权衡，进而提出自适应粒子湮灭调度策略。
AI.motivation: 粒子湮灭对缓解长时间Wigner分支随机游走模拟中的数值符号问题不可或缺，但湮灭频率对长时间精度的影响尚不清楚，实际选择多依赖经验，因此需要为粒子湮灭调度提供系统指导。
AI.method: 通过均匀网格建立粒子湮灭的整体误差估计，将误差分解为Wigner分支随机游走方差、重采样方差和偏差平方；分析湮灭频率引发的偏差—方差权衡；基于新的误差结构提出方差约束下的成本优化策略，用于多种粒子湮灭方法的自适应调度；并利用内在时间重参数化为时变势场下的方差控制、粒子湮灭调度和分支动力学提供统一时钟。
AI.result: 分析表明，粒子湮灭不仅控制粒子增长，还将随时间指数增长的方差上界替换为随时间线性增长的上界，从而缓解数值符号问题；频繁湮灭可限制方差，但可能增加累积偏差。数值实验验证了理论方差行为和偏差—方差权衡，所提调度在兼顾精度与效率的经验Pareto前沿上处于低成本区域。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为粒子湮灭频率选择提供了理论依据和系统调度框架，表明自适应粒子湮灭调度可改善长时间模拟中的精度—效率权衡。

title: Solver-consistent learned curvature for algebraic volume-of-fluid simulations of rising bubbles: symmetry-preserving networks, closed-loop data aggregation and a posteriori benchmarks
summary: Curvature reconstructed from compressed volume fractions exhibits a persistent force-weighted bias in the tested algebraic volume-of-fluid formulation. In OpenFOAM interFoam, face curvature is underestimated by 11-22% for radii of 2.5-40 cells, explaining the 14-17% static Laplace-pressure deficit. This bias is consistent with approximately 2% rise-velocity underprediction in the first Hysing benchmark. We estimate curvature from 5 x 5 volume-fraction stencils using a two-hidden-layer perceptron with exact phase-exchange antisymmetry and invariance under all eight square-grid symmetries. Training uses solver-generated profiles of periodic translating bubbles, droplets, and flat films with exact analytical curvature labels. Iterative data aggregation incorporates model-solver feedback and resolves deployment instabilities found in 15 of 76 periodic cases with the initial model. Band-weighted face interpolation supplies the same capillary force to momentum prediction and pressure correction. Independent tests show static pressure-jump errors of 2-6% and reductions in time-averaged maximum capillary numbers by factors of 2.8-16. Across three grids, time-integrated rise-velocity errors decrease from 2.06-2.76% to 0.65-1.04% in the first Hysing benchmark and from 5.64-8.72% to 4.72-7.61% in the second. Tuned curvature smoothing gives smaller static pressure-jump errors, but its first-benchmark accuracy deteriorates with refinement and second-benchmark gains remain marginal. A separate interface-gated dissipative momentum closure achieves a held-out coefficient of determination of 0.47 on Favre-filtered targets but changes rise velocity by less than 0.03% of its peak. Capillary-force discretisation is therefore the more influential correction target for the tested laminar bubbles.

AI.tldr: 该文诊断 OpenFOAM interFoam 代数 VOF 中由压缩体积分数重建曲率产生的力加权偏差，并提出基于 5×5 模板和对称性约束 MLP 的曲率估计与带状加权面插值，以降低 Laplace 压力与 Hysing 气泡上升速度误差。
AI.motivation: 测试的代数 VOF 公式中，曲率重建存在持续力加权偏差：interFoam 在 2.5–40 个网格半径下低估面曲率 11–22%，对应 14–17% 静态 Laplace 压力亏损，并与第一 Hysing 基准约 2% 的上升速度低估一致，因此需要修正毛细力离散化。
AI.method: 从 5×5 体积分数模板用双隐藏层感知机估计曲率；模型具严格相交换反对称性，并对正方形网格全部 8 种对称变换不变。训练数据为求解器生成的周期平移气泡、液滴和平面液膜剖面，标签为解析曲率；采用迭代数据聚合纳入模型-求解器反馈，解决初始模型在 76 个周期案例中 15 个出现的部署不稳定。带状加权面插值把同一毛细力用于动量预测和压力修正。另评估调参曲率平滑和界面门控耗散动量封闭。
AI.result: 独立测试中静态压力跳变误差为 2–6%，时间平均最大毛细数按 2.8–16 倍因子降低。三套网格上，第一 Hysing 基准的时间积分上升速度误差由 2.06–2.76% 降至 0.65–1.04%，第二基准由 5.64–8.72% 降至 4.72–7.61%。调参曲率平滑降低静态压力跳变误差，但第一基准精度随网格加密而变差，第二基准收益仍有限。单独界面门控耗散动量封闭在 Favre 滤波目标上的留出决定系数为 0.47，但使上升速度变化小于峰值的 0.03%。
AI.conclusion: 对测试的层流气泡，毛细力离散化是比耗散动量封闭更有影响力的修正目标；所提曲率重建与一致毛细力插值可减小静态压力跳变和上升速度误差，但曲率平滑和动量封闭的额外收益有限或存在网格加密退化。

title: Frequency Multiplexing of Purcell-Enhanced Optically Coherent NV Centers
summary: Integrating optically coherent quantum emitters into nanophotonic structures is key to scalable quantum networks. Realizing them with nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond is hindered by the degradation of optical coherence accompanying nanofabrication. Here, we overcome this challenge by integrating multiple NV centers into a monolithic diamond photonic crystal nanocavity while preserving near-lifetime-limited optical coherence. We observe linewidths as narrow as 19 MHz, enabling the frequency multiplexing of spectrally distinct NV centers within a common cavity mode, while maintaining charge-state stability over several minutes under resonant excitation. Tuning the cavity into resonance with the NV zero-phonon line enhances the optical emission, consistent with Purcell enhancement predicted by finite-element simulations. Additionally, individual cavities can be independently brought into resonance with NV zero-phonon lines on the same chip. These results combine bulk-like optical coherence with frequency multiplexing and cavity-enhanced emission, establishing a scalable nanophotonic platform for NV-based quantum network nodes.

AI.tldr: 该文将多个金刚石NV色心集成到单片金刚石光子晶体纳米腔中，在保持近寿命极限光学相干性的同时，实现19 MHz窄线宽、同一腔模内的频率复用、数分钟电荷态稳定以及腔增强发射，并证明同一芯片上多个腔可分别与NV零声子线共振。
AI.motivation: 实现可扩展量子网络需要将具有光学相干性的量子发射器集成到纳米光子结构中；但金刚石NV色心在纳米加工后光学相干性退化，阻碍了其应用。
AI.method: 将多个NV色心集成到单片金刚石光子晶体纳米腔中，测量其光学线宽、电荷态稳定性和腔模共振特性；将腔与NV零声子线共振以增强发射，并用有限元模拟预测Purcell增强；在同一芯片上独立调节多个腔与NV零声子线共振。
AI.result: 观测到窄至19 MHz的线宽，使光谱不同的NV色心可在共同腔模内频率复用；在共振激发下电荷态稳定数分钟；腔与NV零声子线共振时发射增强，并与有限元模拟预测的Purcell增强一致；同一芯片上的单个腔可分别与NV零声子线共振。摘要未给出具体Purcell因子、增强倍数及纳米加工细节。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将类体材料的光学相干性、频率复用和腔增强发射结合起来，建立了可用于NV色心量子网络节点的可扩展纳米光子平台。

title: Gas expansion in global models of nanosecond pulsed discharges: a reduced gas-dynamic model coupled to plasma kinetics
comment: 54 pages, 14 figures, plus 7 pages of supplementary material
summary: Global (zero-dimensional) kinetic models of nanosecond pulsed discharges describe the expansion of the heated gas channel (kernel) with simplified gas-dynamic closures. We show that these closures can lead to errors of tens of percent in the calculated gas density, temperature and species densities, especially in the first microseconds after every pulse. Here, we propose a fast, reduced gas-dynamic model of Lagrangian shells, closed by an approximate cylindrical acoustic radiation condition, with no fitted physical coefficient. The reduced model reproduces the axis density obtained by verified one- dimensional compressible computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations within 2.4% for smooth deposition profiles and axis pressures up to six times ambient, typically a thousand times faster than CFD. We couple it with our in-house global plasma-kinetics solver (SoPlasma-0D), whose energy partition after the pulse agrees well with that derived from measurements and with an independent calculation. Two microseconds after a single pulse in air, and compared with the proposed coupled model, the existing closures overestimate the axis density by up to a factor of 2.8, the atomic oxygen density by up to 2.7 and the temperature by up to 680 K. For repetitive pulses 200 or 430 ns apart, of equal energy per unit volume, no existing closure follows the coupled model at both intervals, in the gas density met by each later pulse and in the energy per molecule deposited by late pulses, which sets how strongly they dissociate and heat the gas. The proposed reduced model should therefore be used to describe the gas evolution during the expansion phase after every nanosecond pulse, and for repetitive pulses above about 100 kHz in kernels of radius up to about a millimetre.

AI.tldr: 该文指出零维纳秒脉冲放电全局模型中简化的气体动力学闭合会在脉冲后最初数微秒造成数十百分比误差，进而提出一种快速降阶的拉格朗日壳层气体动力学模型，并用近似圆柱声辐射条件闭合、无需拟合物理系数；该模型与一维可压缩CFD及SoPlasma-0D耦合，精度高且约快千倍，并量化了现有闭合在单脉冲和重复脉冲下的显著偏差。
AI.motivation: 全局（零维）纳秒脉冲放电模型通常采用简化的气体动力学闭合来描述加热气体通道（kernel）的膨胀，但这些闭合可能在计算气体密度、温度和组分密度时产生数十百分比误差，尤其是在每个脉冲后的最初几微秒。因此需要一种快速且准确的气体演化模型。
AI.method: 提出一种快速的降阶气体动力学模型：采用拉格朗日壳层描述，并以近似圆柱声辐射条件闭合，不使用拟合物理系数。将该模型与作者自研的全局等离子体动力学求解器SoPlasma-0D耦合；并与已验证的一维可压缩CFD模拟以及测量推导和独立计算进行对比。
AI.result: 降阶模型在平滑沉积剖面和轴压高达环境压力6倍的条件下，将轴密度复现到与一维可压缩CFD模拟相差2.4%以内，且通常比CFD快约一千倍；与SoPlasma-0D耦合后，脉冲后的能量分配与测量推导及独立计算吻合良好。单脉冲空气中2微秒后，与耦合模型相比，现有闭合将轴密度高估至多2.8倍、原子氧密度高估至多2.7倍、温度高估至多680 K。对于间隔200 ns或430 ns、单位体积能量相同的重复脉冲，没有现有闭合能在两个间隔下同时符合耦合模型所给出的后续脉冲所遇到的气体密度以及晚期脉冲沉积的每分子能量。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的降阶模型应被用于描述每个纳秒脉冲后膨胀阶段的气体演化，并适用于约100 kHz以上、kernel半径至约1毫米的重复脉冲情形。

title: Solving the Discretised Shallow Water Equations on Distorted Structured Grids with Neural Physics
summary:
This paper presents a method for solving the shallow water equations on highly distorted structured grids using convolution-based operators following the Neural Physics approach. By mapping distorted physical grids to a uniform computational domain with Jacobian transformations, the governing advection and diffusion operators are reformulated in a structured convolutional form. This enables the use of efficient stencil-based operations and, following the Neural Physics concept, we do this through convolutional layers whose weights are determined by the chosen numerical methods rather than by training.
  The method introduces consistent mass-lumped formulations, conservative and non-conservative advection forms, and a diffusion operator, all expressed as convolutions. A nonlinear Petrov-Galerkin stabilisation is incorporated to control numerical oscillations on distorted meshes. Two approximations for the Laplacian operator are also proposed to accelerate pressure and diffusion solves. The framework is validated using the Carlisle 2005 flood event, demonstrating accurate predictions of water depth and velocity on distorted meshes for both linear and quadratic discretisations.
  The results show that distorted structured grids can retain conservation, stability and accuracy, whilst adapting the mesh statically. The convolutional formulation makes the method well suited to Neural Physics implementations and GPU acceleration, offering a scalable approach for flood modelling and large-scale geophysical simulations.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种基于卷积算子与Neural Physics思想的方法，在高度畸变的结构化网格上求解浅水方程，并通过Carlisle 2005洪水事件验证其水深刻画与流速预测能力。
AI.motivation: 针对高度畸变结构化网格上浅水方程求解的需求，力图在保持守恒性、稳定性和精度的同时利用结构化卷积算子，适配Neural Physics实现与GPU加速，并服务于洪水建模和大规模地球物理模拟。
AI.method: 通过Jacobian变换将畸变物理网格映射到均匀计算域，将控制方程中的平流与扩散算子重写为结构化卷积形式；采用权重由数值方法而非训练确定的卷积层。方法包含一致质量集中格式、守恒与非守恒平流形式、扩散算子、用于抑制畸变网格数值振荡的非线性Petrov-Galerkin稳定化，以及两种用于加速压力与扩散求解的Laplacian近似。采用Carlisle 2005洪水事件进行验证，覆盖线性与二次离散。
AI.result: 在畸变网格上对水深和流速给出准确预测，线性和二次离散均得到验证；结果表明畸变结构化网格可在静态自适应网格条件下保持守恒性、稳定性和精度。摘要未提供定量误差或性能数据。
AI.conclusion: 卷积化表述使该方法适合Neural Physics实现和GPU加速，为洪水建模及大规模地球物理模拟提供可扩展途径；畸变结构化网格可兼顾守恒、稳定与精度。

title: The role of turbulent jet dynamics on contrail formation from conventional and sustainable aviation fuels
summary: Large-eddy simulations (LES) coupled with a discretised population balance equation (PBE) are used to quantify the effect of turbulence on the early stages of contrail formation (jet regime) for both conventional (soot-rich) and sustainable aviation fuels (SAFs). SAFs typically have low aromatic content which causes a shift in the dominant nucleation pathway. The contribution from soot (non-volatile particulate matter, nvPM) is reduced, while the contribution from volatile particulate matter (vPM) is increased. The computational domain reproduces an experimental jet configuration that replicates the thermodynamic conditions encountered in the upper troposphere. The LES-PBE simulations capture well the jet-core cooling and bracket the experimental values of ice-crystal characteristics (number concentration, mean diameter and mass density) if a range of judicious values for parameters not specified in the experiments are employed. With the aid of one-dimensional, one-way coupled PBE approach, it is shown that soot particle activation can be reliably captured using steady aerosol-jet models. On the other hand, volatile particle activation is significantly affected by large fluctuations in temperature and humidity (and thereby supersaturation). Further downstream, non-linear dynamic coupling between the gas and aerosol phases becomes increasingly important for ice-crystal growth as well. Overall, the results demonstrate that for SAFs, turbulence is an important driver of particle activation and subsequent ice crystal growth and cannot be neglected. This finding motivates more fundamental studies to assess how turbulent jet dynamics modulates contrail formation in realistic engine configurations.

AI.tldr: 该文用LES耦合离散化群体平衡方程（PBE），量化湍流对常规富碳烟燃料与可持续航空燃料（SAF）在喷流阶段早期凝结尾迹形成的影响；结果表明SAF条件下湍流对颗粒活化和冰晶增长尤为关键。
AI.motivation: SAF芳香烃含量通常较低，会改变主导成核路径：碳烟（非挥发性颗粒物，nvPM）贡献降低，挥发性颗粒物（vPM）贡献增加。因此需要评估湍流在喷流阶段早期凝结尾迹形成中的作用，尤其是对SAF颗粒活化与后续冰晶增长的影响。
AI.method: 采用大涡模拟（LES）耦合离散化群体平衡方程（PBE），计算域复现实验喷流构型及上对流层热力学条件；并用一维、单向耦合PBE方法辅助分析碳烟颗粒与挥发性颗粒的活化过程。
AI.result: LES-PBE模拟较好捕捉喷流核心冷却，且在采用一组合理参数值时可包络实验冰晶特征（数浓度、平均直径和质量密度）；这些参数在实验中未被指定。一维单向耦合PBE表明，稳态气溶胶-喷流模型可可靠捕捉碳烟颗粒活化；挥发性颗粒活化则显著受温度、湿度及过饱和度大幅波动影响，下游气体-气溶胶相间的非线性动态耦合对冰晶增长也愈发重要。
AI.conclusion: 对SAF而言，湍流是颗粒活化及后续冰晶增长的重要驱动因素，不可忽略；该发现支持进一步开展基础研究，以评估真实发动机构型中湍流喷流动力学如何调制凝结尾迹形成。摘要未提供具体燃料种类、参数取值及定量结果范围。

title: Variable-length MDI QKD under source imperfections and local randomization over horizontal links
summary: Quantum key distribution (QKD) provides security guarantees that hold despite device imperfections and finite-size effects. We address these challenges in measurement-device-independent (MDI) QKD, combining its intrinsic untrusted detection with an imperfection model for Alice's and Bob's sources via fidelity bounds. We establish variable-length general security under the Marginal-constrained Entropy Accumulation Theorem (MEAT), estimating the relevant Rényi entropies through conic optimization. We evaluate our model under a horizontal channel link, reporting secret keys for blocks as small as n~3x10^4 rounds under atmosphere-free conditions, and show that compensating for unequal channel attenuation through appropriately chosen transmitted amplitudes improves performance in asymmetric configurations, enabling communication distances beyond 80 km for commercial satellite systems.

AI.tldr: 该文在MDI-QKD中引入基于保真度界的源缺陷模型，利用MEAT建立可变长度一般安全性，并通过圆锥优化估计Rényi熵；结果显示小块长可生成密钥，幅度补偿改善非对称链路，商用卫星系统可超80 km。
AI.motivation: 量子密钥分发需在设备不完美和有限码长效应下仍提供安全保证；MDI-QKD虽具备内在的不可信探测优势，但仍需对Alice和Bob的源缺陷进行建模，并将该模型与MDI-QKD的安全性分析结合。
AI.method: 通过保真度界刻画Alice和Bob源的缺陷，结合MDI-QKD的不可信检测；在Marginal-constrained Entropy Accumulation Theorem（MEAT）框架下建立可变长度一般安全性；利用圆锥优化估计相关Rényi熵；在水平信道链路下评估模型，并通过选择适当的发送幅度补偿非对称信道衰减。
AI.result: 在无大气条件下，块长小至n~3×10^4轮仍可报告密钥；在非对称配置中，补偿不相等的信道衰减可提升性能；在商用卫星系统场景下可实现超过80 km的通信距离。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了结合源缺陷建模与MDI-QKD的有限码长、可变长度安全分析，并表明其在小型块长和非对称链路中的可行性；摘要未提供具体密钥率、详细协议参数及实验或部署验证细节。

title: A generic route to chaos in self-excited plasma oscillations
summary: We propose a generic autonomous route to chaos in self-excited plasma oscillations through nonlinear feedback from a finite-rate charging variable. Near the threshold of an oscillatory ion-acoustic instability, a multiple-scale reduction yields a Stuart-Landau amplitude equation, represented by a van der Pol-type modal surrogate and coupled to debris-charge evolution in a prototype case of plasma-debris interaction scenario. For a debris-induced ion-ion counter-streaming instability, charge-dependent forcing and frequency modulation, finite charging relaxation, phase-lagged modal response, mixed nonlinear feedback, and saturation form a closed dynamical system without an externally imposed periodic driver. Numerical bifurcation and Lyapunov analyses reveal multistability and a bounded chaotic branch reached through period doubling bifurcation and band formation. We test the proposed mechanism using a one-dimensional open-boundary \emph{hybrid} particle-in-cell-Monte Carlo collision simulation incorporating particle collection, photoemission, secondary-electron emission, and surface regulation. Weak-form sparse regression identifies finite intervals whose projected dynamics reproduce the sign structure of the reduced model, while independent $0$-$1$ chaos test, nonlinear predicatbility, surrogate-data, and Lyapunov diagnostics provide localized evidence of deterministic chaotic organization in the subsonic case. The combined results establish a proof-of-principle route by which a self-excited plasma mode can become chaotic through internally generated charging feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出并数值验证了一种无需外部周期驱动的自治混沌路径：有限速率充电反馈使自激等离子体振荡经周期倍化形成有界混沌分支，并在混合PIC-MCC模拟中获得局部确定性混沌证据。
AI.motivation: 旨在回答自激等离子体振荡能否仅通过内部生成的有限速率充电非线性反馈自主进入混沌，并在等离子体-碎片相互作用的原型场景中检验该机制；摘要未进一步说明具体应用背景。
AI.method: 在振荡型离子声不稳定性阈值附近采用多尺度约化得到Stuart-Landau振幅方程，并以van der Pol型模态代理表示，与碎片电荷演化耦合；针对碎片诱导的离子-离子对向流不稳定性，将电荷依赖强迫、频率调制、有限充电弛豫、相位滞后模态响应、混合非线性反馈和饱和纳入一个无外部周期驱动的闭环动力系统。采用数值分岔与Lyapunov分析，并使用一维开放边界混合粒子网格-蒙特卡洛碰撞模拟，包含粒子收集、光电子发射、二次电子发射和表面调节；还用弱形式稀疏回归识别投影动态区间，并结合0-1混沌检验、非线性可预测性、替代数据和Lyapunov诊断。
AI.result: 数值分岔与Lyapunov分析揭示多稳态以及经周期倍化分岔和频带形成到达的有界混沌分支。弱形式稀疏回归识别出若干有限区间，其投影动态重现约化模型的符号结构；0-1混沌检验、非线性可预测性、替代数据和Lyapunov诊断在亚声速情形提供确定性混沌组织的局部证据。摘要未给出具体参数范围、定量Lyapunov指数或实验验证结果。
AI.conclusion: 结果建立了原理性证明：自激等离子体模式可通过内部生成的充电反馈进入混沌，形成一条自治混沌路径。

title: Physics-Spawned Neural Integration of Rotating Shallow-Water Dynamics
summary: Equation-derived neural integration can execute prescribed dynamics without training, while informative ensemble learning can estimate uncertain parameters and identify governing interactions without requiring differentiability. Together, these approaches motivate Physics-Spawned Informative Networks ($Φ$SpIN), a framework for prescribed and adaptive hybrid dynamical systems. As a first step toward flood modeling applications, we present $Φ$SpIN-SW, its prescribed-physics realization for the rotating shallow-water equations. Compatible C-grid operators on spherical Voronoi meshes define a computational graph that retains non-polynomial operations and advances the state through recurrent neural integration compiled with JAX. Analytical benchmarks characterize numerical errors, and global and coastal experiments closely reproduce reference solutions generated using the Model Prediction Across Scales (MPAS) model. At approximately 14~km global resolution, A100, H200 and B200 GPUs attain 9-, 19- and 34-fold higher timestep throughput than a 96-core MPAS-SW CPU reference under matched workloads. These results extend training-free neural integration beyond polynomial dynamics to complex geophysical simulation, establishing a computational foundation for subsequent adjoint-free ensemble estimation of physical and neural parameters and informative adaptation of operator structure.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ΦSpIN 混合动力系统框架，并给出其规定物理实现 ΦSpIN-SW：在球面 Voronoi 网格上以 C-grid 算子构建计算图，用 JAX 编译循环神经积分，无需训练即可求解旋转浅水方程；全球和海岸实验复现 MPAS 参考解，GPU 时间步吞吐显著高于 CPU 基准。
AI.motivation: 动机是结合两类互补思路：方程导出的神经积分无需训练即可执行规定动力学，信息性集合学习可在不要求可微的情况下估计不确定参数并识别控制相互作用；作者据此构建规定与自适应混合动力系统框架，并以洪水建模应用为首要方向，先用 ΦSpIN-SW 实现规定物理部分。
AI.method: ΦSpIN-SW 针对旋转浅水方程，在球面 Voronoi 网格上采用兼容的 C-grid 算子定义保留非多项式操作的计算图，并通过 JAX 编译的循环神经积分推进状态；使用解析基准刻画数值误差，并开展全球与海岸实验，与 MPAS 模型生成的参考解对比；在约 14 km 全球分辨率、匹配工作负载下比较 A100、H200、B200 GPU 与 96 核 MPAS-SW CPU 的时间步吞吐。
AI.result: 全球与海岸实验 closely 复现 MPAS 参考解；在约 14 km 全球分辨率下，A100、H200 和 B200 GPU 的时间步吞吐分别达到 96 核 MPAS-SW CPU 参考的 9 倍、19 倍和 34 倍；解析基准用于表征数值误差。摘要未给出更详细的精度指标。
AI.conclusion: 结果将无训练神经积分从多项式动力学扩展到复杂地球物理模拟，建立了计算基础，用于后续无需伴随的物理与神经参数集合估计以及算子结构的信息性自适应；ΦSpIN-SW 本身是规定物理实现，集合估计与自适应属于后续工作。

title: Dynamics and stability of volatile thin liquid films on a heated vertical cylinder
summary: Volatile thin liquid films flowing down heated vertical cylinders are central to many heat transfer applications, including evaporative condensers, cooling of electronics, and solar thermal systems.
